title: #CORE Product Manager Windchill CorePDM (d/f/m)
description:
Job Description:

Take flight with Airbus Helicopters!

Airbus Helicopters is looking for a Windchill CorePDM Product Manager to join the Physical Product department based in Marignane, France or Donauwörth, Germany.

Join us to shape the future of aeronautics and contribute to protecting lives during missions carried out by our helicopters.

The Marignane site, the 3rd largest industrial site in France, located near Marseille and Aix-en-Provence, is undergoing a profound transformation to offer a high-tech, inclusive, and environmentally friendly work environment.

You will enjoy a unique professional experience at the very heart of our helicopter manufacturing operations.

To learn more about our site and activities: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=flu57j6g-0g

Your future responsibilities:

You will join the End To End Develop domain team, which deploys digital solutions for our entire helicopter development process, from end to end.

Within this team, you will manage the Windchill CorePDM application, dedicated to the Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) of our helicopters.

Your main responsibilities :

- Roadmap: Define the overall roadmap for the Windchill application at an enterprise level, working in close collaboration with the Client/Product Owner, Technical Leader, and IT Operation Specialist.
- Governance: Co-lead the governance of the application, with specific responsibility for the technical scope.
- Strategy: Align the Windchill strategy with the broader digital transformation and corporate governance objectives.
- Release Management: Take full responsibility for release content. Organize and plan the design, development, and deployment of application enhancements in coordination with the architect, technical leader, and development team.
- Communication: Plan communication and ensure that all business stakeholders are kept clearly informed.
- Costs: Manage the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) of the Windchill platform, including licensing, major upgrades, and vendor relations.
- Group Approach: Drive and foster synergies across the Airbus Group.
- Risk Management: Raise alerts regarding risks and propose action plans to maintain the software on a supported/maintainable version, ensure compliance with Part-IS regulations, and mitigate cyber threats.
- User Satisfaction: Identify opportunities and design a product that satisfies both the customer and the end-user, while respecting Time, Quality, and Cost (TQC) commitments.

Your Profile :

- Minimum 5 years of professional experience in product management or a similar field.
- Excellent understanding of the aerospace / industrial engineering office environment (design, configuration management, product definition).
- Good understanding of PLM systems, ideally the Windchill CorePDM application.
- Hands-on experience with Agile methodologies and ways of working.
- Strong collaboration and communication skills within complex environments.
- Full autonomy in managing the role.
- Fluent English is mandatory, combined with an advanced level of German or French.

3 Reasons to join us :

- Our Values: Six core values form the heart of our company. Defined for employees by employees, our Airbus values shape the DNA of our business, reflecting the unique blend of qualities found in every member of our global family.
- Inclusion and Diversity: We foster an inclusive and rewarding work environment where everyone's diversity is valued and respected. An inclusive and diverse workforce drives innovation at Airbus. It makes us unique and contributes to better problem-solving.

Compensation and Benefits:

At Airbus, we build the future together, and your success is our priority.

You can expect a comprehensive, competitive, and transparent total rewards package (including base salary, bonuses, profit-sharing, incentive schemes, and a preferred employee share ownership plan), designed to reward both the individual and collective impact you bring.

We invest in your overall growth and well-being :

- Professional development: Training, mentoring, and international mobility.
- Health & Retirement: Comprehensive health insurance and pension plans.
- Work-life balance: Strong commitment to flexibility and parental support.

And for your day-to-day life, perks that make a difference:

- A dynamic CSE (Works Council): Offering numerous benefits such as a subsidized company restaurant, children's holiday camps, sports clubs and facilities, travel allowances, and more.
- Commuter benefits: Take advantage of our company shuttle buses or the reimbursement of your annual transit pass.

Our recruitment process :

- Apply online.
- Application review by the recruitment department.
- Security clearance: Our positions require security clearance; please complete the questionnaire that will be sent to you.
- Recruitment interviews: Attend the interviews (an HR interview and a technical interview with your future manager).
- Receive your job offer!

Job Description:

#DIGITAL CAMPUS - IAM IT Operation and Service Manager

An opportunity for an IT Operation and Service Manager has arisen within

Airbus Helicopters (Albacete, Spain)

WHY JOIN US?

📍 LIFE IN ALBACETE: QUALITY & CONVENIENCE -

Albacete is a dynamic, historic city in Spain, located in the region of Castilla-La Mancha. This modern urban center, known for its rich cultural heritage, and it is conveniently close to Madrid and the Mediterranean coast.

Forget long commutes. Albacete offers you the great advantage of a “15-minute city": safe, accessible, comfortable and perfectly connected. Enjoy a premium standard of living at a competitive cost, ensuring you have the perfect balance between your career and your personal life.

🚁 AIRBUS HELICOPTERS: GROW WITH US - We offer more than a job; we offer a community. Immerse yourself in a young, collaborative environment that feels like family. As a strategic Center of Excellence, we are a global leader in helicopter production, offering you endless potential to grow alongside our major projects.

✨THE PROJECT: SHAPING THE FUTURE - Welcome to the Digital Campus, a pioneering ecosystem dedicated to industrial digitalization and innovation. This is more than just a workplace; it is a technological hub where we define the future of flight.

Bring your ideas to a dynamic, modern ecosystem and help us build the next generation of aerospace solutions.

DESCRIPTION

- We are looking for an IAM IT Operations and Service Manager to join the Identity and Access Management PSL (Product Service Line) in Albacete, Spain. IAM PSL is part of IM (Information Management), in the Infrastructures & Digital Platforms department.

Identity and Access Management (IAM) products enable our internal and external users to be properly identified, authenticated & authorized to access Airbus Helicopters and Airbus Group Applications.

The AH IAM PSL delivers and deploys the solution, products and services with an end-to-end accountability. We will manage the products lifecycle, both developing the products and operating them, in close relationships with Airbus Group.

Our Access IT products sustain Authentication, Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Encryption and digital certificates. And our Identity IT Products sustain User management (Provisionning/Deprovisionning, Privileged accounts, Recertification, …) and Directory services (Identity Directory, Metadata Synchronization, …)

The IAM IT Products are mainly : PingIdentity products (PingFederate and PingID), F5 Big-IP and Microsoft PKI for Access. And Active Directory, Identity Management, OneLogin for Identity. Automation is running on Ansible; Cyber IAM is based on Oradad, PingCastle and Silvefort; Incident and Change management on Service NOW. The compliance dashboard uses Palantir Foundry.

You will be welcome in a dynamic and empowered team, within an international context, where teamwork and solidarity are key values.

YOUR CHALLENGES

The role of an Identity and Access Management IT operator is to work with IM Airbus Helicopters organization. Your job will be to act as Access IT Operation specialist and you will be the backup of the Access Products Managers when required.

The scope to be covered is the technical and functional management of the Products: F5, PingID & Pingfederate applications, PKI and password manager.

Your job will be split in 4 main domains of activities: Support, Automation, Reporting and CyberIAM. You will perform these 4 domains of activities for the Mother Company mainly, but you could also cover the Customer Center.

It will lead to the delivery of the following IM services:

Support & RUN Operations:

- Performs the ITIL based support processes that include incident, problem, change, configuration, and event management.

- Analyses error messages, diagnoses system failures and takes corrective action in order to ensure continuity of operations, escalating to other technical teams (L3) and vendors as needed.

- Perform the daily check (anticipation), perform the troubleshooting, and propose, follow and perform improvement on known processes

- Covered all activities and operational tasks for all restricted perimeter.

Technical Support & Operations Management

- Act as the technical backup for the F5 and Access Product Managers.

- Perform or lead change executions on Access Products with external administrators.

Automation:

- Perform and maintain scripting; develop and maintain the automated tasks

- Monitors automated tasks, notify in case of issues and resolve automation incidents.

Reporting & CyberIAM:

- Monitor system logs and alerts, investigating and responding to potential security incidents in a timely manner.

- Perform the daily request, perform the troubleshooting on Analytics Dashboard dedicated to the targeted Customer Center, and Mother Company.

- Communicates improvement, updates and obsolescence management of products to the Customer Centers local IT.

SKILLS

- Master's degree level (or equivalent) in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.

- 0 to 3 years of experience as an IT Operator or System&Network Administrator. Ideally, experience in Identity and Access Management in an industrial context.

- Knowledge of the ITIL framework (ServiceNow experience is a plus).

- Knowledge of modern authentication & authorization concepts and protocols (SAML, OIDC, OAuth2, RADIUS, MFA).

- Basic understanding of networking and application delivery (F5 BIG-IP concepts: VIPs, Pools, SNAT, SSL/TLS certificate management, and HTTP traffic analysis ).

- Knowledge of scripting and automation languages (PowerShell, Python, Bash, or Ansible) and familiarity with Java syntax for OGNL expressions)

- Self-driven, motivated, constantly learning on the job and creative.

- Ability to act both autonomously and as a strong team player.

- Strong verbal and written communication skills.

- Team spirit and good relationship, as well as service spirit and accountability are key values for this job position

- Problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to analyze complex issues and provide effective solutions.

- Fluent English, French is a plus.

WHICH BENEFITS WILL YOU HAVE AS AIRBUS EMPLOYEE?

At Airbus we are focused on our employees and their welfare. Take a look at some of our social benefits:

- Vacation days plus additional days-off along the year (Apróx. 35 days per year in total).

- Attractive salary.

- Hybrid model of working: we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

title: Aerospace  Cyber Security System Architect (d/m/w)
description:
Job Description:

To support the team, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a Aerospace Cyber Security System Architect (d/m/w).

About Us & Role Description

The Cyber Division of Airbus Defence and Space is a European specialist in cyber security for defence and aerospace assets and systems. More than 450 cyber experts in our offices in France, Germany, the UK and Spain leverage our Airbus DNA by developing products and solutions for customers based on state-of-the-art, trusted technologies. Our mission is to design, develop, integrate and deliver tailored cyber security products and solutions for defence, government and institutional customers and provide operational support throughout the system life cycle.

This role can also be performed with reduced weekly working hours and an adapted scope of responsibilities.

Your Location

Our Ottobrunn/Taufkirchen location is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful state capital of Bavaria. Do you like sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are just an hour away and offer a wide range of leisure activities.

You can also work at our locations in Immenstaad/Friedrichshafen on the beautiful Lake Constance or in Bremen near the North Sea coast!

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive salary and individual benefits, e.g., employer-funded pension plans, mobility offers (e.g., bike/car leasing), or employee discounts at cooperating companies according to our applicable guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days paid vacation according to collective agreement (35h/week); compatibility of family & career (flexitime, mobile working, part-time, job sharing, sabbatical).
- Moving Ahead Made Easy: Excellent upskilling opportunities and great international, group-wide development prospects.
- Well-being at Work: On-site medical officer for check-ups and health services, comprehensive health programs, canteen and cafeteria, and a kindergarten close to the site.
- Diversity Connects: Working in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, support, and diversity are actively lived and every voice is heard.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Provide end to end support to projects with regards to cyber security.
- Lead the definition of Security requirement , security concept for specific projects.
- Lead the Design of Secure architecture for Aerospace Solutions
- Lead the Security Risk Assessment and Threat Modeling Processes
- Act as Security Officer for certain Aerospace Projects and be the point of contact for all related security topics
- Verification and Validation of Cyber-security System/Network design
- Evaluate, develop and adapt Baseline for secure system and network configuration and hardening aligned with security requirement
- Support the Bid Team with the technical solution (security scope) and effort estimation
- Coordinate with the different stakeholders and team members to ensure the delivery of the technical solution on-quality, on-time and on-cost (oQoToC)

Desired skills and qualifications

- You are educated to a degree in aerospace engineering, electrical engineering, communications, computer science or similar, or comparable experience
- You have several years of experience in system security engineering and the definition of security concept and processes for complex solution for Space and Aviation systems
- You have good knowledge of the different Cyber Security standards and frameworks ( e.g. ISO 27000 Family, NIST 2 , CMMC, ...) and you are well-versed in Security Products and Secure Communications Protocols
- You possess strong expertise with Secure Architecture Principles and Concepts ( e.g Zero Trust , Defense in Depth, Least Privilege…)
- You are knowledgeable of the Risk Assessment framework (e.g. EBIOS , NIST SP800-37..)
- You have a solid understanding to define verification and validation procedures for secure architecture
- Your excellent communication and writing skills in English set you apart; German would be a plus

Not a 100 percent match? No problem! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

Nous vous proposons de rejoindre Airbus Atlantic, leader industriel mondial en matière d'aérostructures, de sièges pilotes et de fauteuils passagers de classe affaires et de première classe. Nous innovons sans cesse pour définir de nouveaux standards d’excellence industrielle. Nous préparons le futur pour une industrie aérospatiale compétitive et durable.

Êtes-vous notre prochain Airbus Atlantic - Responsable Architecture IT (All Gender) ?

Vous piloterez la stratégie et les opérations liées à l'architecture du système d'information, aux standards technologiques et aux plateformes de développement logiciel. À ce titre, vous garantirez la cohérence, la performance et la pérennité du système d'information pour soutenir les ambitions de croissance, de résilience et de transformation digitale d'Airbus Atlantic.

🎯 Votre mission

1. Management et Pilotage d'Équipe (9 collaborateurs)

- Encadrement et Développement : Assurer le management hiérarchique et fonctionnel d'une équipe de 9 experts en architecture. Animer la performance collective, piloter la gestion de la charge et accompagner le développement des compétences individuelles.
- Gouvernance de l'Activité : Prioriser et superviser le traitement des demandes d'architecture (études d'opportunité, dossiers d'architecture technique, expertises ponctuelles).
- Pilotage de la Performance : Définir, déployer et suivre les indicateurs clés de performance et de résultats afin de mesurer l’efficience du service et d’inscrire l’activité dans une démarche d’amélioration continue.

2. Urbanisation et Architecture du système d'information

- Gouvernance et Standards : Définir et faire évoluer les principes directeurs de l'architecture d'entreprise ainsi que le référentiel des standards informatiques. Veiller à leur stricte application dans l'ensemble des projets et des solutions déployées.
- Comité d'Architecture : Piloter et animer l’Architecture Gate, instance décisionnelle chargée de valider la conformité des dossiers d'architecture avant leur mise en production.
- Gestion du Référentiel et Veille : Garantir la cartographie et la mise à jour continue du référentiel d’architecture (processus, applications, données, infrastructures). Assurer une veille technologique active pour identifier les innovations de rupture et anticiper les obsolescences.
- Centres d'Expertise : Coordonner et animer les Centres d’Expertise transverses afin de favoriser le partage de connaissances et l'alignement technologique.
- Usine Logicielle : Porter la responsabilité des solutions d'intégration et de déploiement continus pour standardiser et accélérer les développements logiciels internes.
- Security-by-Design : Garantir l'intégration des exigences de cybersécurité dès les phases amont des projets, en étroite collaboration avec le Responsable de la Sécurité des Systèmes d'Information.
- Infrastructures Socles & Multicloud : Définir et faire évoluer les architectures de virtualisation/HCI, les architectures conteneurisées et l'hybridation Cloud.
- Middlewares & Écosystème d'Intégration : Garantir la cohérence des middlewares, des plateformes d'API Management, des services d'automatisation et des flux d'échange de données sécurisés.
- Architecture OT & Digitalisation Industrielle : Concevoir les architectures d'intégration entre le SI et les équipements d'usine en cohérence avec les contraintes d'extensibilité et de disponibilité des lignes de production.
- Infrastructure as Code & Automatisation : Inscrire l'architecture technique dans une trajectoire d'automatisation poussée pour réduire la dette technique et accélérer la mise à disposition des environnements.

3. Gestion des Partenaires et Fournisseurs

- Pilotage de la Prestation Externe : Rédiger les cahiers des charges et piloter les appels d'offres pour les prestations de conseil ou d'expertise en architecture.
- Catalogue de Services : Structurer, valoriser et maintenir le catalogue de services de l'équipe d'architecture à destination des autres directions métiers et IT.

Vous justifiez d’une expérience managériale confirmée auprès d’équipes hautement techniques, ainsi que de la direction d’architectures de système d'information d’envergure, idéalement acquises dans un environnement industriel ou aéronautique.

Fort d’une maîtrise éprouvée des frameworks d’architecture d’entreprise, vous vous appuyez sur une solide culture générale des domaines (Réseaux, Cloud/On-Premise, PLM, ERP type SAP, MES) et sur une excellente compréhension des architectures modernes couplées aux pratiques DevOps/DevSecOps.

Vous savez appréhender les enjeux globaux de l’entreprise et anticiper ses besoins futurs et porter des projets transverses créateurs de valeur.

Doté d’une excellence relationnelle et d’un réel sens de la diplomatie, votre leadership vous permet de négocier, d’influencer et d’aligner efficacement les parties prenantes à haut niveau.

Job Description:

Au sein de nos équipes, l’Architecte Cybersécurité d’Entreprise s’assure que les choix techniques et technologiques des projets IT et métiers respectent la stratégie de sécurité de l’organisation.

Il constitue l’autorité sécurité technique sur les architectures des SI d’entreprise, définit les modèles de sécurité et accompagne le développement des architectures, en cohérence avec la stratégie IT et les politiques de sécurité de l’organisation.

Votre futur job, si vous l’acceptez…

Vos activités en tant qu’Architecte Cybersécurité d’Entreprise seront articulées autour de 4 thématiques principales et des activités types :

- Conception

- Établir la stratégie des architectures de sécurité des SI en lien avec la stratégie métier, les objectifs de sécurité issus d’analyse de risque et la stratégie de sécurité globale de l’entreprise

- Appliquer des modèles de référence pour les architectures

- Contribuer à la déclinaison des politiques de sécurité en standards de sécurité opérationnels

- Préconisation

- Accompagner les chefs de projet dans le design de l’architecture, spécifier les différents paramétrages et définir les exigences techniques de sécurité

- Conseiller sur le choix des solutions techniques et préconiser des architectures sécurisées pour des SI ; s’assurer de sa conformité réglementaire le cas échéant

- Revoir régulièrement l’architecture existante, identifier les écarts et faire des recommandations d’amélioration de la sécurité

- Définir les stratégies de tests et de validation sécurité et veiller au suivi des recommandations

- Conseil

- Conseiller sur l’utilisation et la combinaison des briques de sécurité existantes

- Analyser les enjeux de sécurité liés à l’introduction de nouvelles technologies ou de nouveaux systèmes d’information

- Assurer une veille sur les nouvelles menaces et en tenir compte dans la définition des architectures de sécurité

- Communication

- Contribuer à la montée en maturité sécurité des SI auprès des architectes techniques et des urbanistes

- Collaborer avec les spécialistes techniques de sécurité pour consolider une vue globale de la sécurité défensive des SI

Vulgariser vos connaissances techniques avec les autres fonctions techniques et non techniques.

- Professional English needed (written and spoken) (Professional proficiency level)

- Conception d’architecture sécurisées

- Cryptographie

- Gestion des identités et droits d’accès (IAM)

- Sécurité des réseaux et protocoles de communication

- Sécurité dans les systèmes d’exploitation

- Méthodes de conception, Ingénierie Système et sécurité

- Auditabilité des systèmes et gestion des incidents

En tant qu'expert en gestion des risques, vous utiliserez des méthodologies reconnues (EBIOS RM, ISO 27005) pour fournir une vision claire et actionnable des menaces, aidant ainsi les décideurs à faire des choix d'investissement éclairés en matière de sécurité.

Missions & Responsabilités

En vous basant sur la méthodologie fournie, votre mission principale consistera à mener des analyses de risque de bout en bout, avec pour objectifs spécifiques :

Phase d'Analyse et Modélisation du Risque

- Définition du Cadre : Définir le périmètre d'étude, cartographier les actifs critiques, les dépendances et les parties prenantes, tout en intégrant le cadre réglementaire applicable (PART-IS, RGPD, NIS2, LPM, etc.).
- Identification des Risques : Identifier les menaces, les acteurs malveillants et leurs motivations. Déterminer et modéliser les scénarios de risques les plus critiques et leurs impacts potentiels (matériels, financiers, réputationnels).
- Évaluation et Hiérarchisation : Déterminer la probabilité et la gravité des risques pour les hiérarchiser. Recenser les protections existantes et évaluer leur efficacité pour identifier les lacunes de sécurité.
- Traitement du Risque : Proposer des mesures de réduction, d’acceptation ou de transfert des risques, en définissant des plans d'action pragmatiques et priorisés.

Phase de Communication et de Suivi

- Rédaction et Présentation : Rédiger des livrables de qualité (rapports d'analyse de risque, plans de traitement) et présenter les résultats aux équipes techniques et aux directions pour valider les décisions.
- Gestion et Suivi : Assurer la gestion de projet de l'analyse de risque, planifier le suivi des risques résiduels et contribuer à l'intégration de la gestion des risques dans la gouvernance globale de nos clients.
- Veille et Conseil : Maintenir une veille constante sur les évolutions des menaces cyber (TTPs) et des normes/réglementations pour adapter en permanence les approches d'analyse.

- Expérience : Minimum 6 ans d’expérience significative dans le management des risques cyber et l'analyse de risque.

- Maîtrise d'EBIOS RM 2018 et des méthodologies de gestion des risques (notamment ISO 27005, NIST).
- Connaissance approfondie des menaces cyber, des attaques (techniques, tactiques, procédures) et des vulnérabilités.
- Maîtrise des exigences de l'ISO 27001, RGPD, NIS2, et de la LPM.

- Compétences Méthodologiques et Transverses

- Définition et priorisation des mesures de sécurité.
- Gestion de projet de l'analyse et suivi des risques.
- Excellente communication et d'adaptation à l'audience pour interagir avec des équipes techniques et des directions.

- Veille cyber et adaptation aux évolutions des menaces et des normes.

title: Aircraft Technical Services PMO (F/H)
description:
Job Description:

Envolez-vous avec Airbus Helicopters !

Airbus Helicopters recherche un Aircraft Technical Services PMO (F/H) pour rejoindre le service de PMO transverse du département Aircraft Technical Services (ATS) basé à Marignane, France.

Rejoignez-nous pour façonner l'avenir de l'aéronautique et contribuer à protéger des vies lors des missions accomplies grâce à nos hélicoptères.

Le site de Marignane, 3ème site industriel français, près de Marseille et d'Aix-en-Provence se transforme en profondeur pour offrir un environnement de travail de haute technologie, inclusif et respectueux de l'environnement.

Vous vivrez une expérience professionnelle unique, au cœur de la fabrication de nos hélicoptères.

Pour en savoir plus sur notre site et nos activités : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=flu57j6g-0g

Vos futures missions :

En rejoignant notre équipe, vous participerez à différentes missions, toutes orientées vers une amélioration de la gouvernance et de la performance du département. Ensemble, nous contribuerons à l’activité du département Aircraft Technical Service (ATS) qui vise à être le meilleur de sa catégorie en matière d'expertise et de support technique, de données techniques, d'ingénierie de maintenance, de services numériques et d'opérations de MRO aéronautique. Vous transformerez les données opérationnelles clés en analyses stratégiques à fort impact, permettant une communication fluide avec la direction et les parties prenantes externes.

Vos principales missions seront les suivantes :

- Piloter la feuille de route financière : Piloter la création, la consolidation et l'exécution des prévisions de coûts (Costs Forecasts - FC) d'ATS. Vous synchroniserez de manière proactive les activités demandées par les clients internes et externes pour définir, sécuriser et verrouiller le budget face aux objectifs de l'entreprise.
- Orchestrer la planification des ressources et de la capacité : Structurer le plan de travail futur en équilibrant charge de travail et capacité. Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans l'exécution de notre stratégie « Faire ou Faire faire » (Make or Buy), en veillant à ce que les ressources internes et externes soient parfaitement alignées avec l'évolution des besoins opérationnels d'ATS.
- Optimiser la base de coûts : Élaborer et suivre le budget de référence (heures productives, frais de personnel, OpEx, CapEx, achats, déplacements) pour le Support Ingénierie. Votre suivi analytique garantira le strict alignement des dépenses réelles avec le plan stratégique.
- Coordonner les jalons projets : Travailler en étroite collaboration avec la Finance et le Contrôle de gestion pour préparer les revues et jalons clés, en veillant à ce que l'ensemble des activités s'aligne sur les objectifs d'ATS et de l'entreprise.
- Garantir la conformité de la sécurité de l'information (ISO 27001 ou NIST) : En travaillant avec le Système de Management de la Sécurité de l'Information (SMSI), vous serez le point de contact privilégié pour soutenir le programme d'audits internes, signaler les incidents et servir d'interface et de référent technique pour les besoins de l'EASA et des autorités nationales.

Votre profil :

- Formation et expérience : Diplôme d'ingénieur ou Master en gestion/finance (Bac+5), appuyé par 2 à 5 ans d'expérience en PMO, gestion de portefeuille de projets ou contrôle de gestion industrielle.
- Pilotage financier et budgétaire : Expertise confirmée en consolidation budgétaire, prévisions de coûts (Costs Forecasts) et suivi analytique approfondi des dépenses (OpEx, CapEx, heures productives, achats).
- Gestion des ressources et planification : Solide maîtrise de l'arbitrage charge/capacité et expérience pratique dans l'exécution de stratégies d'externalisation de type Make or Buy.
- Conformité & Sécurité de l'information : Connaissance opérationnelle des standards de cybersécurité (ISO 27001, NIST) et familiarité avec les exigences des autorités réglementaires aéronautiques (AESA/EASA).
- Analyse de données : Capacité à transformer de grands volumes de données opérationnelles complexes en indicateurs de pilotage synthétiques et pertinents pour la direction (maîtrise avancée d'Excel, Power BI, SAP ou outils équivalents).
- Aisance relationnelle et transversalité : Excellentes compétences de communication pour faire la passerelle entre des interlocuteurs aux enjeux très différents (ingénieurs support, équipes finance, chefs de projet et direction).
- Bilinguisme anglais : Maîtrise de l'anglais technique et professionnel (écrit et oral), indispensable.

3 Raisons pour nous rejoindre :

Nos Valeurs : Six valeurs essentielles constituent le noyau de notre entreprise. Définies pour les employés par les employés, nos valeurs Airbus façonnent l'ADN de notre activité, en reflétant le mélange unique des qualités que l'on trouve dans chacun des membres de notre famille mondiale.

Inclusion et diversité : Nous favorisons un cadre de travail inclusif et valorisant, où la diversité de chacun est appréciée et respectée. Une main-d'œuvre inclusive et diversifiée est le moteur de l'innovation chez Airbus. Elle nous rend unique, contribue à une meilleure résolution des problèmes.

Rémunération et avantages :

Chez Airbus, nous construisons l'avenir ensemble et votre succès est notre priorité.

Attendez-vous à un package de rémunération global, compétitif et transparent (incluant salaires, primes, intéressement, participation et plan d'actionnariat privilégié), conçu pour récompenser l'impact et la performance que vous apportez, à la fois individuelle et collective.

Nous investissons dans votre épanouissement complet : développement professionnel (formation, mentorat, mobilité internationale), couverture santé, retraite, et un engagement pour un équilibre vie pro/vie perso soutenu (soutien à la parentalité, flexibilité).

Et pour votre quotidien, des avantages qui font la différence :

- Un CSE dynamique proposant de nombreux avantages (restaurant d'entreprise, centre aéré pour les enfants, associations et complexe sportif, indemnités de voyages, etc.).

- Facilités de transport : Profitez de nos navettes d'entreprise ou du remboursement de votre pass annuel de transport.

Notre processus de recrutement :

1. Candidatez en ligne.

2. Analyse de votre candidature par le service recrutement.

3. Nos postes nécessitent une habilitation de sécurité, complétez le questionnaire qui vous sera envoyé.

4. Réalisez les entretiens de recrutement : entretien RH et entretien technique avec votre futur manager.

5. Recevez l’offre d’embauche !

​

Prêt à vous envoler ? Donnez une nouvelle dimension à votre carrière en candidatant en ligne maintenant !

description:
Job Description:

Airbus Defence and Space Cyber est un leader européen de la cybersécurité, opérant notamment dans les domaines de l'aérospatiale et de la défense.

Ce sont d'abord nos équipes qui font la différence:

Plus de 450 spécialistes, hautement qualifiés, venant d'horizons divers, travaillent ensemble pour développer et déployer des solutions de cybersécurité sur mesure qui protègent les clients gouvernementaux, militaires et institutionnels. Ils sont tous animés par une même ambition: contribuer à renforcer la sécurité et la stabilité de nos organisations et de nos nations.

Vous souhaitez en faire partie? Nous recherchons toute l'année des personnes talentueuses et engagées telles que vous pour nous rejoindre !

Airbus Defence and Space Cyber ​recherche un Architecte Cyber Sécurité SIEM/SOC (f/h) pour rejoindre notre équipe basée à Toulouse, France.

Votre rôle sera d’assurer le pilotage technique de projets de mise en place d’écosystèmes de CyberDéfense et de mise sous supervision système en prenant en compte :

- Les risques et les menaces

- La réglementation et les bonnes pratiques applicables

- Le compromis coût/efficacité/besoin opérationnel

Votre environnement de travail :

Capitale mondiale de l'aéronautique et capitale européenne de la recherche dans le spatial, Toulouse est une ville dynamique du sud-ouest de la France desservie par un aéroport international. Idéalement située entre la mer Méditerranée et l'océan Atlantique et à proximité des Pyrénées, elle offre de nombreuses possibilités d'activités de plein air !

Parce que nous prenons soin de vous :

- Avantages financiers: Salaire attractif, accords d’intéressement et de participation, plan d'épargne salariale abondé par Airbus, plan d’actionnariat salarié sur la base du volontariat, avec attribution d'actions gratuites en fonction du nombre d'actions souscrites.

- Équilibre vie privée / professionnelle : Des jours de congés supplémentaires pour occasions spéciales et des options de transfert de congés, un comité d'entreprise proposant de nombreuses activités socio-culturelles et sportives et d’autres services.

- Bien-être / santé : couverture complémentaire des frais de santé et de prévoyance (incapacité, invalidité, décès). Selon le site : centre de services de santé, services de conciergerie, salle de sport, application de covoiturage.

- Développement individuel : des opportunités d’évolution et des possibilités de formations nombreuses (catalogue de plus de 10.000 e-formations disponibles en libre accès pour développer votre employabilité, certifications, programmes de développement accéléré, parcours expert, mobilité nationale et internationale).

Chez Airbus, nous vous aidons à travailler, à vous connecter et à collaborer plus facilement et de manière plus flexible. Partout où cela est possible, nous favorisons la flexibilité dans nos modes de travail afin de stimuler l'esprit d'innovation.

Vos challenges :

En tant qu'Architecte Cyberdéfense SIEM/SOC (h/f), vos missions seront les suivantes :

- Pilotage de la mise sous supervision SOC de périmètres client

- Spécification et conception de systèmes de CyberDéfense,

- Suivi de l’intégration du système et de son maintien en condition,

- Définition de la politique de supervision SOC,

- Rédaction de propositions techniques dans le cadre de consultations et réponses à appels d’offre,

- Rédaction de documents d’études (état de l’art, étude prospective, etc.) et de veille technologique,

- Définition des moyens pour les équipes SOC/CSIRT/Analyste de sécurité pour la mise en œuvre de systèmes de CyberDéfense.

Vous interviendrez sur des projets d’envergure internationale à forte valeur ajoutée pour nos clients de la Défense, du spatial et de l'aéronautique.

Ce poste nécessite une habilitation de sécurité ou nécessite d'être éligible à une habilitation par les autorités reconnues.

Votre profil :

Titulaire d’une formation de niveau BAC +5 en informatique ou équivalent avec une expérience d’au moins 5 ans dans le domaine de la cybersécurité, vous possédez les compétences techniques suivantes.

- Gestion des événements de sécurité d’un système d’information (SIEM, Log Management System),

- Connaissance des systèmes de détection d’intrusion (NIDS, NIPS, HIDS),

- Conception et architecture de systèmes et réseaux sécurisés

- Expérience acquise sur systèmes d'exploitation Linux/Unix,

- Compétences en ingénierie système,

- Connaissance d’au moins une des normes et réglementations en sécurité informatique,

- Maitrise de l’anglais obligatoire.

Seront également appréciées :

- Une connaissance des systèmes de réponse aux incidents de cybersécurité (SOAR, EDR)

- Des connaissances sur la mise en place de solutions de détections comportementales

Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour les qualités suivantes :

- Capacité à se former en permanence et à s'adapter aux évolutions techniques

- Esprit d’équipe, ouverture d’esprit, sens de l’entraide et transparence

- Curiosité d’esprit et dynamisme

Vous ne matchez pas à 100% ? Pas d'inquiétude ! Airbus vous accompagnera dans votre plan de développement.

description:
Job Description:

CE QUE NOUS FAISONS :

NOUS SOMMES LES PIONNIERS DE LA CYBERSÉCURITÉ DANS LA DÉFENSE ET L'AÉROSPATIALE

Vous souhaitez en faire partie? Nous recherchons toute l'année des personnes talentueuses et engagées telles que vous pour nous rejoindre!

Airbus Defence and Space Cyber est un leader européen de la cybersécurité, opérant notamment dans les domaines de l'aérospatiale et de la défense. Ce sont d'abord nos équipes qui font la différence: Plus de 800 spécialistes, hautement qualifiés, venant d'horizons divers, travaillent ensemble pour développer et déployer des solutions de cybersécurité sur mesure qui protègent les clients gouvernementaux, militaires et institutionnels. Ils sont tous animés par une même ambition: contribuer à renforcer la sécurité et la stabilité de nos organisations et de nos nations.

Rejoignez l'équipe Airbus !

VOTRE RÔLE : Airbus Defence and Space Cyber recherche un/une Architecte Cybersécurité (f/h) pour rejoindre notre pôle Architecture Sécurité des Systèmes d’Information basé en région Parisienne (Boulogne-Billancourt / Elancourt) ,France.

Vous ferez partie d'une équipe qui développe des solutions de cybersécurité critiques pour des clients de haute importance. Dans le cadre de notre département d’ingénierie dédié aux projets, vous serez impliqué(e) dans la conception globale de la sécurité des systèmes d’information visant à garantir la protection des données et des infrastructures de nos clients.

Ce qui rend ce rôle unique est la diversité des enjeux : vous travaillerez sur des projets de haute importance pour le Ministère des Armées, les ministères régaliens et les institutions européennes. C'est une opportunité idéale pour un expert en sécurité souhaitant évoluer vers la conception et l'architecture dans un environnement de défense et de souveraineté.

COMMENT VOUS ALLEZ CONTRIBUER À L'ÉQUIPE : Votre mission sera de transformer les besoins de sécurité en architectures concrètes et robustes. Vos principales responsabilités seront :

- Conception et Ingénierie : Rédaction des exigences de sécurité et conception des architectures fonctionnelles et techniques des systèmes d'information.
- Accompagnement à l'Homologation : Réalisation d'analyses de risques et rédaction des dossiers d'homologation pour garantir la conformité des systèmes.
- Appui au Développement : Accompagnement des phases de développement, d'intégrationn, de validation et de maintien en condition opérationnelle et de sécurité (MCO/MCS).
- Support Commercial : Participation active aux réponses aux appels d'offres par l'élaboration de solutions techniques et l'estimation des coûts.
- Expertise et Leadership : Animation de réunions techniques, présentation et défense de vos architectures lors de soutenances ou de Groupes de Travail (GT SSI), rôle de responsable technique sécurité.
- Innovation et Veille : Identification des technologies émergentes et proposition de solutions innovantes (automatisation, Zero Trust, etc.) pour maintenir un niveau de résilience de pointe

À PROPOS DE VOUS :

- Expertise Technique en Sécurité : Expérience significative dans la conception et l'intégration de la sécurité de systèmes d'information (systèmes d'exploitation, gestion des identités/IAM, réseaux, PKI, containers, virtualisation ou Cloud).
- Capacité de Conception : Aptitude à passer de l'analyse de risques à la définition d'une architecture technique, avec une bonne maîtrise des méthodes d'ingénierie (Cycle en V ou Agile).
- Aisance Relationnelle et Rédactionnelle : Excellentes capacités de synthèse et de rédaction, ainsi qu'une aisance pour présenter et défendre des sujets techniques complexes devant des interlocuteurs variés.
- Anglais Professionnel : Bonne maîtrise de l'anglais, tant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit.
- Profil Évolutif : Vous possédez une solide expérience en sécurité et souhaitez donner un nouvel élan à votre carrière en devenant Architecte.

Un plus pour votre candidature (Expertise Défense ou Spatiale) :

- Une connaissance ou une expérience des enjeux de cybersécurité appliqués au secteur spatial (sol/satellite) ou secteur défense (Ministère des Armées, OTAN, EDA) ou sera fortement appréciée.
- Une connaissance du ou des cadres réglementaires Défense (Ministère des Armées, OTAN, Union Européenne, ESA) et des processus d'homologation en particulier pour l'ESA ou Union Européenne sera également fortement appréciée.

VOTRE EMPLACEMENT :

Ce poste nécessitera un présence permanente dans les locaux de l'un de nos partenaires à Issy Les Moulineaux (92).

Le poste pourra être rattaché administrativement au choix à notre site de Boulogne-Billancourt (92) ou Elancoute (78).

Boulogne-Billancourt (92), France

Aux portes de Paris la ville de Boulogne-Billancourt offre un cadre agréable doté de nombreux espaces verts. La ville est bien désservie par les transports en communs rendant le site de Airbus facilement accessible.

Elancourt (78), France

A deux pas du Château de Versailles et située à proximité de Paris, Elancourt est une ville dynamique, faisant partie de l'agglomération de Saint-Quentin-en-Yvelines.Plusieurs options sont disponibles pour se rendre sur le site d'Airbus par les transports en commun.

VOYAGES : Voyages occasionnels vers France et Europe.

PARCE QUE NOUS PRENONS SOIN DE VOUS:

- Avantages financiers: Salaire attractif, accords d’intéressement et de participation, plan d'épargne salariale abondé par Airbus, plan d’actionnariat salarié sur la base du volontariat, avec attribution d'actions gratuites en fonction du nombre d'actions souscrites.

- Équilibre vie privée / professionnelle : 30 jours de congés, des jours de congés supplémentaires pour les occasions spéciales ou pour raisons familiales, des options de transfert de congés, un Comité d'Entreprise proposant de nombreuses activités socio-culturelles et sportives et d’autres services.

- Bien-être / santé : Couverture complémentaire des frais de santé et de prévoyance (incapacité, invalidité, décès). Selon le site : centre de services de santé, services de conciergerie, salle de sport, application de covoiturage.

- Développement individuel : Des opportunités d’évolution et de nombreuses possibilités de formations avec un catalogue de plus de 10 000 e-formations disponibles en libre accès pour développer votre employabilité, certifications, programmes de développement accéléré, parcours expert, mobilité nationale et internationale.

title: Business Lead - Identity Compliance
description:
Job Description:

Description

Airbus is seeking a highly motivated Business Lead to join our Identity Compliance team in Bangalore, India. This role is pivotal within the Digital function, bridging the gap between enterprise risk requirements and technical execution.

The Business Lead is responsible for driving global business engagement, identity compliance strategy, and the execution of access certification campaigns. You will translate complex risk requirements into effective governance policies while driving stakeholder adoption and risk mitigation across the organization.

About Us

The Airbus DSF (Foundations, Extended Enterprise, and Roof Security) organization provides critical IT and security services to employees globally. Our Identity Compliance team focuses on improving digital cybersecurity maturity by securing identities and access, enabling robust security controls through advanced Identity and Access Management (IAM) frameworks.

The Business Lead - Identity compliance will work with the Product Manager and platform lead for Identity compliance. Security for Identity is improving digital cybersecurity maturity and effectiveness by securing identities, accounts and accesses. Its aims at enabling the business and security controls focusing on Identity and Access management.

Qualification & Experience

- Graduate or Post Graduate degree with 8+ years of experience in Cybersecurity, Identity Governance, or Compliance.

- Deep expertise in Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) frameworks, including risk-based access recertifications, Segregation of Duties (SoD), and Least Privilege enforcement.

- Strong understanding of compliance standards such as ISO 27001 and GDPR, with experience collaborating with audit teams.

- Proven ability to influence senior leadership and communicate complex risk concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

- Experience in driving change management, user awareness, and training programs for identity compliance initiatives.

- Proficiency in refining business requirements into functional IGA specifications using tools like Radiant Logic, Brainwave GRC, or SailPoint.

- Experience with IGA business workflows (e.g., Radiant Logic, Brainwave GRC, SailPoint or similar) and management tools like Confluence and Zoho.

- Strong project management skills for overseeing large scale compliance campaigns or implementation initiatives.

- Tasks & Accountabilities

As the successful candidate your main tasks & accountabilities are:

- Lead the planning and execution of periodic risk-based access reviews, ensuring high completion rates and remediation.

- Act as the primary interface for application owners and stakeholders, guiding them through compliance workflows and remediation.

- Define and enforce business risk rules and entitlement catalog governance to minimize unauthorized access exposure.

- Collaborate with IAM teams and security stakeholders to align security policies with global business requirements.

- Serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for compliance audits, resolving findings and demonstrating control effectiveness.

- Develop and report business-focused compliance KPIs and executive dashboards to track recertification progress.

- Manage vendor relationships and gather operational requirements to prioritize platform features and technical updates.

- Provide guidance and leadership for business escalations during campaign execution, ensuring corporate security targets are met.

description:
Job Description:

Responsible for the stability, security, and efficiency of the enterprise endpoint computing environment in the China region. Focuses on automated script deployment, patch management, and compliance enforcement leveraging SCCM/MECM platforms. Acts as the Tier 3 technical escalation specialist for Service Desk and Onsite teams, and serves as the primary regional technology liaison collaborating with European/Global teams to align standards with unique Chinese regulatory and business requirements.

ACCOUNTABILITY

SCCM Platform Administration & Software Lifecycle Management :

- Administer the SCCM platform and manage structured device collections to centrally govern China-region endpoint assets.

- Orchestrate end-to-end software lifecycle operations, including packaging, deployment, automated upgrades, and silent removals of unauthorized software via Service Requests (SRs) and Change Requests (CRs).

- Design and publish comprehensive SSRS/SQL reports tracking hardware inventory, real-time software licensing and distribution statuses.

Patch Management & Security Compliance:

- Collaborate with global Patch Management teams to schedule and execute enterprise security patch deployments via SCCM, ensuring alignment with global maintenance windows.

Airbus Helicopters is looking for a Corporate Cybersecurity & Compliance Expert (m/f) to join the Corporate Digital Security team based in Marignane, France.

Join us to shape the future of aeronautics and help protect lives during missions accomplished thanks to our helicopters.

The Marignane site, the 3rd largest industrial site in France, near Marseille and Aix-en-Provence, is undergoing a deep transformation to offer a high-tech, inclusive, and environmentally friendly working environment.

Your future missions :

By joining our team, you will ensure the protection and resilience of our assets against cyber threats, while ensuring compliance with national and international regulatory standards.

Together, we will strengthen the Corporate Security department's efforts in protecting our products and ensuring their compliance with regulations.

The general mission of the Corporate Security department is to protect employees, tangible and intangible assets, as well as the reputation of Airbus Helicopters against any physical, digital, or strategic threat, in order to guarantee business continuity.

Your main missions will be :

- Compliance & Regulation : Lead compliance projects for national and international cybersecurity regulations (e.g., NIS 2, CRA) and provide operational support to the Standardization Compliance Manager.

- Transnational Collaboration & Coordination : Work in close synergy with Airbus Helicopters IT security managers globally and participate in Airbus Group working groups.

Your profile :

Professional Experience Level :

- Solid experience in complying with national and international cybersecurity regulations.

Job-Related Technical Expertise :

- In-depth knowledge of European regulations: NIS 2, CRA, PART-IS.
- In-depth knowledge of project management.
- Risk Analysis: Mastery of the EBIOS RM methodology.
- In-depth knowledge of electronic signature solutions, data protection, and data integrity and authenticity control. Knowledge of ARINC 835, 827, and 665 is a plus.
- Architecture & Networks : Good knowledge of secure network architectures, partitioning, cryptography, operating systems (Linux/RTOS/Windows), and security solutions (SOC, SIEM, firewalls, bastions).
- Languages: French (native/fluent), professional fluent English.

Soft Skills :

- Rigor and Integrity: Strict adherence to regulatory procedures and absolute confidentiality.
- Pedagogy and Communication : Ability to explain security challenges to both technical teams and decision-makers.
- Analytical and Synthesis Mindset : Ability to translate complex technical issues into decision-making summaries.
- Stress Management and Responsiveness : Composure in incident or crisis situations.
- Team Spirit : Ability to work in integrated, cross-functional, and transnational teams.

- Security Clearance : Position requires obtaining Secret-level defense security clearance.

Our Values : Six essential values form the core of our company. Defined for employees by employees, our Airbus values shape the DNA of our business, reflecting the unique mix of qualities found in each member of our global family.

Cyber Detection Engineering Lead (d/f/m)

Role Overview

To support our Digital Security Team, Airbus Defence and Space division is seeking a highly skilled Leader Role for Detection Engineer (d/f/m). This is a critical, high-impact role designed to actively protect our entire organization and our world-class products.

This is a technical, hands-on position that sits at the heart of our defense strategy. You will not simply respond to alerts; you will be the architect of our detection ecosystem—transforming threat intelligence into high-fidelity detection logic and bridging the gap between raw telemetry and actionable security intelligence.

Your location

Our site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria. You are into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options. Possible work locations include Manching, Taufkirchen/Ottobrunn, Immenstaad am Bodensee, and Ulm.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.

- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.

- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.

- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.

- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Lead Detection Strategy: Define the long-term vision for detection engineering, aligning technical roadmaps with organizational risk profiles while standardizing the development lifecycle.

- Engine & Rule Lifecycle Management: Architect, develop, maintain, and optimize high-fidelity detection rules for the SOC while expanding framework coverage against MITRE ATT&CK® and Sigma standards.

- Threat Intelligence Translation: Analyze Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) and translate complex TTPs into proactive, resilient detection logic.

- Automation & Orchestration: Drive "Detection-as-Code" initiatives and engineer automated response playbooks to streamline incident response and minimize manual intervention.

- Technical Mentorship & Escalation: Act as the primary escalation point for complex technical issues, mentoring junior detection engineers and SOC analysts.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Incident Response and SOC teams to ensure deployment of context-rich detections that enable rapid threat containment.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.

- Proven track record in developing use cases and detection logic within a Security Operations Center (SOC) environment, including leadership or mentorship experience.

- Strong proficiency in Python and hands-on experience with automation frameworks to streamline operations.

- Deep technical expertise in Windows and Linux operating systems, including OS internals, system logging, and telemetry analysis.

- Practical background in Red Teaming, Penetration Testing, or an offensive mindset to anticipate attacker methodologies.

- Advanced expertise with the MITRE ATT&CK® framework and Detection-as-Code concepts.

Airbus is on its Digital journey and the objective is to transform the company and to prepare it for the future. This transformation includes new global governance, new ways of working and the implementation of digital business services and platforms. As a part of this transformation journey we

Challenges are numerous and exciting.!

About the team & the Role

Security threats have increased drastically in the last few years and organisations are facing an increasingly complex threat landscape. As Airbus continues its digital transformation, numerous opportunities emerge along with new risks.
The Security Architects are in charge of providing Cybersecurity consultancy and support to business teams and projects within Airbus Digital function; Contribute to the roll-out of the Security-by-Design architecture; Represent Airbus Digital Security department as secure design ambassadors; Create
privileged partnership with major business domains and efficiently contribute to the design and the architecture of new solutions and backbones.

As a Cyber Security Architect, you will:

● Have a collaborative mindset, and be a real team player (motivated & motivational)
● Challenge traditional ways of thinking and propose new ideas
● Provide professional cybersecurity consultancy and advisory to business projects
● Adopt and promote security-by-design approach with different project stakeholders
● Proactively contribute to the business solutions’ design and architecture
● Design and architect following a comprehensive risk-based methodology
● Manage and contribute to the publication of Digital Security Standards and Blue Prints in collaboration with Product managers, solution architects, operational teams and security experts.
● Act as the IT/IS Security focal point in his/her domain
● Establish and maintain privileged relationship with major business domains
● Ensure the good reporting for her/his activity

Qualification & Experience
● Bachelor to Master Degree in a Technical/IT discipline or equivalent experience
● Security Specialist on one ( or several) of the following technologies domains :
1. Windows security

3. Kubernetes/dockers/containers security
4. Public cloud Azure/AWS/GCP security
5. Mainframe (Z/Os family) security
6. Crypto / PKI / HSM / vaults
7. 3DX/Catia security
8. Workday authorization
9. Workday security
10. PLM /windchill security
11. Identity and access management (IAM, MFA, SSO, ID Federation ,
authN/AuthZ….etc.)
12. Bastion security
13. GCP/Gsuite security
14. Virtualization security (Hypervisors, VDI …etc.)
15. Storage security
16. ZeroTrust & Network security
17. Active directory security
● Demonstrable consultative approach through internal or external organizations with real customer-centric mindset.

● Exposure and working knowledge of architecting or securing HR Digital solutions. (on-prem or SaaS)
● Certified to, or able to demonstrate strong working knowledge of ISO27001, CISSP or CSSP, CEH, OSCP etc.
● Proven Track record in IT Security environment, IT/IS Architecture design and standards creation
● Previous significant experience on AWS/Azure, Firewalls, Bastion, SIEM, DLP, IAM, MFA /UFA, EDR, Encryption, antimalware, MPLS/SDWAN, IDS/IPS, proxies , HSMs, DevOps, sandboxes etc. is a plus.
● Ability to tackle of large range of security topics from hardware, networks, systems,applications to data, and new digital capabilities
● Security Audit and risk management
● Excellent communication and negotiation skills
● Excellent Organisational and interpersonal skill
● Leadership skills with the ability to drive a multi-functional team

● You will be part of a truly international team
● Travel opportunities (domestic and international)
● Competitive remuneration, bonus and incentives
● Good work / life balance and career growth opportunities
● Training and development opportunities (online, classroom, conferences)
● Comprehensive benefits package ( health insurance, life insurance)

● Grasp and understand Cyber vulnerabilities to connect them to risk

fulfilment & service availability

● Customer-first mindset

● Effective conflict management

title: Cyber Security Architect (d/f/m)
description:
Job Description:

A vacancy for Cyber Security Architect (d/f/m) has arisen within the Defence and Strategic Programmes team of Airbus Cybersecurity in Spain. We provide products, development, concepts, and cybersecurity engineering to internal and external customers in Airbus. As a European specialist, Airbus shields customers, agencies, and critical infrastructures from cyber threats.

We are looking for experienced Cyber Security Architect with proven experience in the defence and aerospace domains. In the role of Cyber Security Architect the main responsibilities are:

1. Product security governance throughout its entire lifecycle.

- Support in defining secure architectures for both segments (Air/Ground Segments).
- Security requirements management at different levels (L1, L2, L3) using DOORS.
- Security architecture modeling using Cameo.
- Definition of technical security documents (Architecture, Cryptographic documents, Review Items, Ad-Hoc SRAs, etc.).
- Technical support to DOs (Design Organizations) in discussions with suppliers regarding cyber requirements.
- Technical support in various panels with the Authority and Customer (CISSWG, COMSEC panels, etc.).
- Definition of cybersecurity processes:
- Support in defining the key management process throughout its entire lifecycle (Generation, transport, storage, erasure).
- Support in defining certificate management processes.

2. Security Risk Assessment (SRA) execution, including threat and vulnerability evaluations.

3. Proposal of security solutions (architectures and designs) to ensure compliance with requirements.

4. Evaluation of security requirements implemented in solutions proposed by system designers.

5. Management of formal compliance processes (assessment, certification, and accreditation) under national and international regulations (CC/CEM, ITSEC, etc.).

6. Expert support to systems designers and contribution to R&D+I projects.

7.Monitoring of cyber vulnerabilities and impact analysis to identify mitigation measures.

8. As an integral part of their duties, the employee must fulfill responsibilities regarding occupational risk prevention (ORP), quality, and the environment. This includes strict compliance with all health and safety regulations and procedures established by the company and current legislation; participating in ORP training; correctly using personal protective equipment (PPE) and reporting any unsafe conditions; ensuring all activities are performed according to quality standards; contributing to the continuous improvement of the quality system; maintaining accurate records and participating in quality audits; and participating in sustainability initiatives, promoting the efficient use of resources and waste reduction, and reporting environmental incidents to guarantee a safe, sustainable, and high-quality work environment.

10. As an Airbus SLC employee, you are required to know and comply with established internal policies and procedures, both at the Airbus Group level and those specific to Airbus SLC, and you commit to:

a) Complying with Airbus SLC policies, codes, and standards.

b) Understanding and fulfilling the assigned roles and responsibilities regarding information security, privacy, and confidentiality.

c) Receiving training, awareness, and periodic updates on the entity’s policies and procedures relevant to your position. Acting with due diligence to prevent security incidents. In this regard, an investigation and disciplinary process may be initiated against those who may have caused such incidents. No such process shall commence without prior verification that an incident has occurred.

Education and Training Requirements

- Academic Background: Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or Computer Science.
- Certifications and Compliance:
- Security Clearance: Demonstrated ability to obtain and maintain National / NATO Security Clearance.
- Advanced Knowledge of Certification Standards: Common Criteria (ISO/IEC 15408), ITSEC, or airworthiness regulations (DO-326A/ED-202A).
- Languages: English C1 Level (Advanced) for technical and business communication.

- Knowledge of TRANSEC/COMSEC is an asset / a plus.
- Knowledge of the CIS Accreditation process is an asset / a plus.
- Knowledge of NATO standards is an asset / a plus.

Specific Technical Skills:

- Hands-on experience in Security Risk Assessment (SRA) methodologies.
- Ability to execute hardening on network devices and operating systems.

title: Cyber Security Evaluator (d/f/m) Airborne Products
description:
Job Description:

In order to support our operations, Airbus Commercial is looking for a

Cyber Security Evaluator (d/f/m)

Airbus is a global industrial player and aircraft manufacturer with the highest standards of safety and security. The increasing connectivity of our aircraft and the digitalization of our products have opened the door to new threats and hence to a growing need for security evaluation activities.

To face these challenges, our team, embedded in the Flight and Integration Test Center, acts as the first attacker to anticipate the threats our airborne products could face. Composed of specialists combining multiple competencies in avionics, networks, radio transmissions, operating systems, cryptography and more. This transnational team is recognized company-wide for its unique expertise combining avionics and security skills.

To extend our activities and scope, we are currently looking for a Cyber Security Evaluator (m/f/d) for airborne products, based in Hamburg-Finkenwerder, Germany. Your main role is to perform security evaluations on airborne products and systems and to identify security weaknesses before their entry into service or affecting the in-service aircraft. As our environment is constantly evolving, you also contribute actively to the continuous improvement of our activities by exploring new attack techniques, tracking new technologies, developing scripts and tools supporting the security evaluation of airborne products.

Are you ready for this challenge?

Your Location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

What you will do with us as Airborne Products Cyber Security Evaluator (m/f):

- Using your curiosity, creativity and experience, to develop and perform adversarial security evaluations against Airbus airborne products and related services in our laboratory test environments.
- To evaluate the security of our products and systems, gathering system or multi-system configuration items and performing configuration reviews.
- To contribute to the design, development, implementation and integration of Airbus airborne products applying an attacker mindset and sharing technical expertise with our international community of system designers and developers.
- To identify weaknesses and/or vulnerabilities on hardware & software by using diverse techniques and tools.
- To compile technical reports and presentations to describe findings, to recommend fixes and to support the security risk analysis process.
- To disseminate your developed attack scenarios and obtain technical knowledge within our team
- To contribute to research and development to explore innovative ways to evaluate Airbus products security.
- To develop tools and test means to test airborne systems.

This role will involve some travel for business in Europe and worldwide, and as such, you must be able to travel accordingly.

We are looking for candidates with the following skills and qualities, please do not hesitate to apply (in English) for the position, even if you partially fulfill the list below:

Experience:

- Industrial experience in cyber security evaluations and penetration testing.
- Advanced knowledge of computer science. A diploma in Cyber Security will be appreciated but not mandatory.
- Experience regarding network security
- Reverse engineering of binaries and/or low-level programming experience
- Software development skills to support security evaluations (tooling, etc)
- Experience in CTF (Capture The Flag) challenges is appreciated.

Hard skills:

- Network-related attack techniques (scanning, spoofing and exploitation of wired and wireless communication)
- Deep knowledge on Linux-based systems
- Knowledge of virtualization and containerization solutions
- Tool development in Python
- Vulnerability research techniques (on source or object code): static analysis, dynamic analysis (fuzzing, concolic execution, …) of: C, C++, Python, Java, Bash or other languages
- Knowledge of different architectures (ARM, PowerPC, x86(_64) or FPGA) is helpful
- Radio Frequency skills are appreciated. Knowledge of GPS/GNSS, 4G/5G is a plus.

Softskills:

- Team spirit, curiosity, creativity.
- Aim to develop the ability to communicate effectively and comprehensively to present complex technical approaches and findings.
- Strong analytical and organizational skills with good communication skills in English.

Please include your starting date and salary expectations in your application and apply in English.

Why join us?

1 - Work on adversarial security evaluation for the Airbus airborne product portfolio, incl. aircraft and helicopter equipment and be an active contributor to the safety and security of aviation.
2 - Work in a multicultural environment, on a growing spectrum of activities, on a worldwide perimeter, within a team of security evaluation specialists.
3 - You will have the opportunity to apply your expertise, to develop your skills, competencies and your personal project. You will attend some specialized Cyber Security conferences.
4 - Work in a balanced environment: beyond the many benefits offered to its employees, joining Airbus is also the guarantee of a respectable work-life balance.

Your Benefits

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

title: Cybersecurity Architect (All Gender)
description:
Job Description:

Within our teams, the Confirmed Enterprise Cybersecurity Architect ensures that the technical and technological choices of IT and business projects respect the organization's security strategy.

It constitutes the technical security authority on corporate IS architectures, defines security models and supports the development of architectures, consistent with the IT strategy and security policies of the organization.

You will work on high-stakes activities sometimes combining notions of safety (operation, people), production issues for companies or strategic sectors of the group and for our external clients.

The role:

Your activities as an Enterprise Cybersecurity Architect will be structured around 4 main themes and typical activities:

Design:

- Establish the IS security architecture strategy in line with the business strategy, the security objectives resulting from risk analysis and the overall security strategy of the company

- Define and apply reference models for architectures

- Contribute to the translation of security policies into operational security standards

Recommendation:

- Support projects in the design of the architecture, specify the different settings and define the technical security requirements

- Advise on the choice of technical solutions and recommend secure architectures for IS; ensure regulatory compliance where applicable

- Regularly review the existing architecture, identify gaps and make recommendations for security improvements

- Define security testing and validation strategies and ensure follow-up of recommendations

Advice:

- Advise on the use and combination of existing security bricks

- Analyze security issues linked to the introduction of new technologies or new information systems

- Ensure technological monitoring and take it into account in the definition of security architectures

Communication:

- Contribute to the increase in security maturity of IS with technical architects and urban planners

- Collaborate with technical security specialists to consolidate a global view of defensive IT security

- Popularize your technical knowledge with other technical and non-technical functions.

Are you THE one ?

- You have an engineering school degree (or equivalent) in the field of cybersecurity, OR you have significant experience in cybersecurity.

- You have at least 5 years of experience in security and have worked on major projects in several sectors (Transport, Space, Pharmaceuticals, Banking, etc.)

- You know how to implement the principles of defensive security and know how to carry out your activity independently.

In particular, you know how to highlight several skills in the following themes:

- Secure architecture design
- PKI (Public key infrastructure)

- Cloud
- Cryptography
- Identity and access rights management (IAM)
- Network security and communication protocols
- Security in operating systems

Skills in one of the following areas are also a plus (optional):

- Design methods, System engineering and security
- Security Product Configuration and Hardening
- Systems auditability and incident management

We also expect the following behavioral skills from our experienced employees:

- Able to work cross-functionally within the organization, you do not hesitate to help profiles more junior than you and be a contributor to the Security Architecture Center of Competencies
- A curious and dynamic mind
- Adaptability to different situations and autonomy in your missions
- You begin to develop skills around leadership, self-confidence and sharing

- You begin to develop an interest in security standards and regulations and their relevance and application in your missions

Finally, we also place particular importance on your technical development, expertise and team spirit in our skills centers. You will therefore join technical communities whose objectives are to create this spirit, disseminate knowledge and bring your ideas to life!

As a confirmed profile we will also pay particular attention to the transmission of knowledge to your peers and to technical capitalization. If you are proactive, we are committed to supporting you in bringing your ideas to life!

As an international company, we work in a multicultural environment: an advanced English level is mandatory.

Your recruitment process:

We value human contact. In order to get to know you better, here are the usual steps of our recruitment process after analyzing your application:
● Application file to be filled in, sent by your recruitment officer.
● Technical interview with the manager.
● Interview with the Recruitment Officer.
● Personalized feedback after the process

Your position will be based in Getafe:

Located just 13 km south of Madrid, Getafe is one of Southern Europe’s major technological and industrial hubs.

As a key center for aerospace, defense, and high-tech industries, it offers an exceptional professional environment to work alongside leading experts and drive cutting-edge innovation.

It offers the perfect balance between a booming career and the famous Spanish lifestyle.
