title: Datalink Systems Test Engineer (h/f)
description:
Job Description:

A vacancy for a DataLink Systems Test Engineer (m/f) has arisen within Airbus Commercial Aircraft in Toulouse. You will join a team composed of 20 persons within the Airbus Flight and Integration Tests center. This team is in charge of providing maturity statements of NAVIGATION, SURVEILLANCE and COMMUNICATION systems, following integration tests performed through Benches or Simulators, and Post Test Flights analysis.

Our team vision is to define experiment and industrialize future methods and means to perform those tests, in line with company objectives:

- Contribute to the Autonomy Research & Technology Roadmap for Single Pilot Operation

- Develop New Tests solutions based on new technologies (e.g. Artificial Intelligence..) for testing the next aircraft generation (zero Emission, Single Pilot, Visual Based Landing…)

- Decrease Aircraft Development timeframe while increase systems maturity before their deliveries to our customers

AIR-GROUND COMMUNICATION is a wide range of avionics systems such as HF and VHF radios, Satellite communications (SATCOM), Wireless (Cellular 3G/4G/5G, Wifi, Lifi..), Cockpit AUDIO systems, DATALINK systems and functions.

Powered by an experienced team and a business driven pioneer spirit, the Tests Centre gathers all engineering testing skills:

- From the definition of the testing strategies

- Lab test means design and validation (test rigs and aircraft simulators)

- Lab test means and real aircrafts instrumentation

- System integration in laboratory with real A/C equipments

- Up to flight tests campaigns on the A320, A330, A350, A380 and A400M Airbus development aircrafts.

The Tests Centre is a transnational Center of Competence with teams in Filton, Hamburg, Bremen, Toulouse and Bangalore.

Inside the Tests Centre, you will join the department specialized in integration of many avionics systems such as Air Traffic Management (ATM) systems, Communications, Navigation and Surveillance systems, Flight Management System, Cockpit Displays and Flight Warning systems, Maintenance and Flight Operations systems as well as cyber and physical security.

The Datalink function is in charge of ensuring exchange of messages between the aircraft and the Air Traffic Control or between the aircraft and the airline. It is based on a router which interact with various onboard applications and communication means for Air/ground data exchanges. Therefore it involves many systems and communication protocols such as ACARS (Aircraft Communication Addressing and Reporting System), ATN (Aeronautical Traffic Network), Arinc 429 and Arinc 619.

Tasks & accountabilities

Your main tasks and responsibilities will include:

- Defining testing strategy (Lab and Flight)

- Defining and development follow up of test means and tools and required instrumentation

- Designing test procedures including automatic testing and/or virtual testing when appropriate

- Executing test campaigns on Lab test rigs and A/C Simulators

- Defining flight test campaigns procedures with flight crew and analyse flight test results

- Participating to the development and maturity of latest innovative Datalink aspects driven for AIRBUS future cockpit policies such as introduction of ATN over SATCOM or IP based communications for safety services (ATN/IPS).

This activities include close interactions with many stakeholders:

- Avionics systems testers: FANS, FMS, CMS, ACMS, AOC, FOMAX…

- Communication means testers: VHF, SATCOM, HF

- Supplier, Design Office and Flight test crew

- Datalink service providers: SITA, ARINC

This role will involve some travel for business and as such you must be able to travel accordingly.

You will have the following skills and experience:

- Educated to master degree level (or equivalent) in Systems, Telecommunication or a related discipline

- Strong interest for Technical activities

- Open minded & agile

- IT & Network knowledge would be a plus

- Advanced level of English.

title: Developer - Fullstack (REACT/Java/Python)
description:
Job Description:

Description of the job

Airbus India is looking for a senior Full-Stack Developer to join our team in Bengaluru. You will join the Airline Sciences team within the Digital department.

Join our Product team that will design and build specialized products, utilizing the core capabilities of our simulation/data models. This role is like that of a Solutions Engineer to solve real-world aerospace challenges through rapid digital innovation. Acting as the Product Manager’s technical co-pilot, you will be involved in scoping business needs, build interactive prototypes, and deliver scalable web solutions integrated with the core simulation models and data pipelines.

This role offers end to end development accountability, combining airline operations problem-solving with hands-on full-stack development.

As a software developer, you will be responsible for developing and implementing frontend/backend components using ReactJS, NodeJS, Java, Spring Boot concepts on Microservices. Also, there may be a need to create an application prototype using Python, as part of a Proof-Of-concept.

You will also be responsible for the database, AWS Cloud and DevOps tasks specific to the product delivery aligned to you.

This position will report to a Senior Group Manager/Product Manager within Airbus India. Passion for technology and problem solving are a must have.

Domain: Commercial flight operations, flight navigation, flight data monitoring (FDM/FOQA), ACARS/ADS-B telemetry feeds, airport operations (AODB), fuel optimization, and disruption management.

Tech Stack: Modern frontend frameworks (React), backend services in Python (FastAPI, Django) and/or Node.js/TypeScript, RESTful and GraphQL APIs, Docker, and Cloud platforms (AWS).

Architecture: Microservices, event-driven data ingestion, caching strategies (Redis), and responsive data dashboards.

Please note: This is a modern web application and cloud data engineering role. It is not an embedded systems, avionics firmware, or DO-178C certification position.

Tasks & accountabilities

Your main tasks and responsibilities will include:

The work itself

- Write clean, maintainable, and production-ready code alongside the Lead Developer and Full-Stack Developers.
- Implement backend business logic that encodes complex aeronautical and aircraft operational calculations into software services.
- Participate in sprint planning, code reviews, deployment pipeline configuration (CI/CD), and tier-2 operational troubleshooting for live applications.
- Collaborates with other developers and provides significant contributions to develop specifications, to resolve business client questions, problems solving, bug fixing, testing, and investigating platform issues.
- Participates in all phases of product development lifecycle, from the analysis, design over test and integration to operation of products.
- Researches, evaluates, and develops new tools to improve product development efficiency.
- Deploys, tests and/or integrates highly available, scalable, maintainable, monitored systems and services.
- May assist in development of product user manuals.
- Coordinates the functional and technical integration.
- Defines the test strategy, scripts, scenarios and monitors test execution.
- Determines how existing applications, legacy systems, databases, web interfaces and/or hardware logic, which may be currently operating on multiple platforms, work together to meet the new and emerging enterprise requirements.

With proven capabilities, you may also be involved in:

- Support the Lead Developer in being a technical bridge between specialized applications and centralized core capabilities.
- Architect secure, scalable microservices and API gateways to ingest, process, and display aerospace data.
- Ensure all bespoke solutions comply with global cloud architecture, cyber security, and data governance standards.
- Potential partnership with the Product Manager/Lead during client discovery workshops to assess business needs
- Evaluate customer IT ecosystems, data feeds, and API capabilities to define technical feasibility and architecture blueprints
- Rapidly build interactive prototypes, data flows, and build APIs to demonstrate feasibility and secure stakeholder buy-in

This role may involve some travel for business in Europe and as such you must be able to travel accordingly.

Required skills

We are looking for candidates with the following skills and experience:

The skills you bring

- Bachelor or Master degree in Aeronautical Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering or other related discipline preferred
- 5-7 years of experience in Software Development and especially working hands-on in a fast-paced discovery to design to prototype and industrialize specialized applications, predominantly in the Aerospace/Airline Operations scope
- Knowledge / hands-on experience in handling aviation data and digital application needs (real-life aviation/airline operations products, possibly simulation platforms) is mandatory
- Hands-on experience with frontend development of UI components for ADT applications using ReactJS / Redux technologies
- Experience in Python coding
- Java development (including experience with JDK 8+ preferred) and a strong experience using Spring Framework
- Experience developing multithreaded application in Java to build high performing applications
- Expertize in memory management while doing application design and development and experience of building scalable applications
- Experience in following an agile methodology (SCRUM, KABAN)
- Knowledge of all phases of software development including design, coding, testing, debugging, implementation, and support
- Knowledge and strong experience with GIT
- Ability to thoroughly understand the business issues surrounding each project
- Knowledge and experience in at least one of the following technologies: MySQL, Maven, Spring Framework, Jenkins, JIRA
- Direct interaction with business teams for requirement analysis, issue troubleshooting and resolution, first line support to the users for their business needs.
- Familiarity with version control systems and CI/CD pipelines.
- Good knowledge on designing and implementing APIs, RESTful web-services and SOAP-based Web-services
- Knowledge of AWS Cloud and Microservices architecture
- English: advanced level both verbal and written

Along with the above mandatory skillsets, highly preferable candidates will showcase:

- Experience with client discovery workshops to understand airline operational bottlenecks and solution scoping

AND/OR

- Experience with digital product development within the aerospace / aviation domain

AND/OR

- Hands-on experience with aerospace/aviation data and its usage

AND

- Demonstrated experience integrating AI coding assistants and modern productivity tools into the end-to-end software development lifecycle (ideation, development, automated test generation, and code review).

Success Metrics:

Success will be measured in a variety of areas, including but not limited to

- Deliver business value as defined by product owner and accountable for team’s delivery value as well
- Give a transparent information during the AGILE rituals (Remaining to do and issues encountered) and request help for support
- Consistently ensure the on-time delivery and quality (first-time-right) of the sprints
- Bring innovative cost effective solutions
- Achieve customer satisfaction
- Ability to handle a subject from demand management, to development and support
- Ability to challenge the needs of the clients and provide appropriate solutions

The role will have the following key outputs:

- Strong link with the Airbus Digital organization
- Good quality code and participation in improvement of existing code
- Proactive in providing guidance & inputs for the product’s roadmap

35 hours per week // Half day Fridays! // 25 days holiday plus bank holidays // Pension // Success share // Plus many more flexible benefits!

About us:

Our Digital and Technology Solutions Degree Apprenticeship at Airbus offers a truly unique launchpad for your career. You'll gain a full "university experience" combined with three years of invaluable, real-world industry expertise, all while earning a full-time salary and paying ZERO fees. During this exciting program, you'll dive into diverse digital solutions and platforms and apply industry-leading project management methodologies to deliver critical business projects, directly contributing to our success and your degree.

We are looking for a Digital Operations Apprentice, you will be at the heart of one of the world’s most advanced manufacturing facilities. Your mission is to learn how to translate complex wing-manufacturing and logistics needs into powerful digital solutions.

You will join a multinational digital community, bridging the gap between our shop-floor production teams and global IT systems. Through a structured apprenticeship, you will master SAP ECC/HANA technology and learn how to manage digital products using cutting-edge Agile (SAFe) methodologies.

Under the guidance of your placement managers, you will develop your skills by working on the following activities:

- Requirements Gathering: Collaborate with logistics and manufacturing experts to understand their business needs and turn them into robust IT solutions;
- Agile Product Management: Participate in continuous improvement and help manage the digital Product Backlog using the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe);
- SAP Configuration & Innovation: Learn to configure SAP modules that power our supply chain, while exploring innovative SAP technologies (such as SAP Fiori, HANA, and Warehouse Management);
- Testing & Documentation: Design, test, and document new features and system enhancements alongside technical experts before they go live;
- Deployment: Support the rollout of new digital tools across the Broughton site and other manufacturing plants, ensuring users are trained and ready for change;
- Trend Watching: Keep an eye on external digital and logistics trends to help challenge and improve our current business process.

Over the 3 years, alongside your workplace commitments, you will achieve a fully funded BSc (Hons) in Applied Data Science. The completion of this degree will be intertwined with your work based experiences, part of which will directly contribute to your degree.

You will be studying via our partner Bangor University and local colleges. Your industry based work takes place at our world leading aircraft manufacturer site in Broughton (near Chester), North Wales. Please note, this will require some travel on day release study to a college in North Wales.

We are also believers in experiential learning too, and there are many events that take place that offer exciting opportunities to grow and develop whilst also having fun!

What you will be doing:

This apprenticeship is delivered through a combination of on the job training at Airbus, and university based learning on day release over the duration of the 3 year programme.

You will learn and apply cutting-edge Applied Data Science principles to real-world business challenges. You'll gain invaluable hands-on experience that not only contributes to your degree but also directly adds significant value to our operations.

Key activities of the industry based work of this apprenticeship may include:

- Driving Data-Led Performance: Leading and participating in data analytics projects focused on enhancing our manufacturing performance and extracting actionable insights from complex datasets;
- Innovating with Digital Tools: Researching, evaluating, and developing new digital and AI-powered tools to boost the efficiency of our IT product development lifecycle;
- Shaping Product Development: Engaging in product development initiatives, encompassing the analysis, design, testing, and seamless integration of IT solutions;
- Crafting Bespoke Software: Developing and customizing tailored software solutions that adapt to our evolving business needs and market demands;
- End-to-End Project Management: Managing projects from inception, including gathering requirements, defining technical specifications, architecting solutions, maintaining comprehensive documentation, and overseeing project timelines.

During this time, you will also get to work with various teams in our engineering, design, quality, operations, cyber security, IT solutions and help desk teams, whilst also having the opportunity to pick placements outside of your area of study, including HR, facilities management, recruitment, finance and much more.

Requirements:

This is an ideal role for someone with a keen interest in digital technology, Internet of Things, mobile apps, data analytics, cybersecurity, Generative AI and future tech.

In order to be eligible to this apprenticeship, you must have a minimum of:

- 3 A-Levels as grade C/4 or above, with at least one in Maths, Sciences and IT

OR

- BTEC L3 Extended Diploma and Cambridge Technical Diplomas in Maths, Science or IT/Digital subject, at minimum MMM grade

OR

- Access to HE Diploma Merit Level in either Maths, Science or an IT subject

OR

- Welsh Baccalaureate with either a Maths, Science or an IT subject at H grades

OR

- Equivalent qualifications/Experience subject to validation

AND

- GCSEs 4/C or above in Maths and English Language

**Please note that, due to the funded nature of this programme, applicants with undergraduate degrees in computing/IT are not eligible.

Successful candidates will be able to demonstrate the following:

- Digital savviness: Comfort with tools like Google Workspace;
- Self-motivation and a strong drive for personal development;
- Strong listening and communication skills;
- Flexibility and happiness to work on a wide variety of tasks;
- Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage priorities;
- Technical familiarity: Familiarity with programming languages (e.g., Python, SQL, JavaScript), data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau), or cloud platforms (e.g., Google Cloud, AWS, Azure) is beneficial, but not required;
- Submit your CV stating your grades and if they are predicted or achieved;
- Submit a Cover Letter highlighting your passion and suitability for this apprenticeship.

We want to get to know you—not just your grades or school background so, tell us on your cover letter:

What is it about Airbus that makes you excited to start a career with us? What is it about our company, our values, or the future of aerospace that excites you? We want to hear about what motivates you to pursue this unique path and how you see yourself growing with us.

Think about projects, hobbies, or academic subjects that have given you practical experience. This could include personal projects, academic work and extracurricular activities.

description:
Job Description:

Start date: September 2027

Location: Filton, Bristol

Duration: 4 years and 3 months

University: Weston College (UCW), degree accredited by the University of the West of England

Degree: BSc (Hons) Digital and Technology Solutions

Apprenticeship standard: ST0119 Digital and Technology Solutions Professional Level 6

Application closing date: Applications will be open until 26 October 2026. After this date, the advert will close once sufficient applications are received. Early submission is recommended.

Application: We love your interest in joining Airbus! There is no limit on the number of positions you can apply for. However, please be aware that you can only progress in the selection process for one position at a time. We recommend reviewing all available opportunities and applying to those that best match your experience and aspirations.

Benefits:

Salary: £23,245

35 hours per week // Half day Fridays! // 25 days holiday plus bank holidays // Pension // Success share // Plus many more flexible benefits!

About us:

Our Digital and Technology Solutions Degree Apprentices get the unique opportunity to work across a wide variety of teams within Airbus, giving you the “university experience” with 4 whole years of invaluable industry experience. During the exciting scheme, you will get the opportunity to work with many different IT applications. You will follow industry leading project management methodologies to deliver successful business-critical projects, whilst earning a full-time salary and paying ZERO fees to do so.

The apprenticeship gives you the unique opportunity to work in a wide variety of disciplines including:

- Cyber Security;

- IT Service Delivery Management;

- Data Analytics;

- Operational Technology;

- Software Development;

- Information Management.

​Over the 4 years, alongside your workplace commitments, you will achieve a fully funded BSc (Hons) in Digital and Technology Solutions. The completion of this degree will be intertwined with your work based experiences, part of which will directly contribute to your degree.

You will be studying via our training partner Weston College (UCW), and your degree will be accredited by the University of the West of England. Your industry based work takes place at our world leading aircraft manufacturer site in Filton, Bristol.

What you will be doing:

This apprenticeship is delivered through a combination of on the job training at Airbus, and university based learning on day release over the duration of the 4 year programme. You will learn key skills in Digital and technology and have the opportunity to apply real world analytical practices, which will contribute directly to your degree whilst adding value to our business.

Key activities of the industry based work of this apprenticeship may include:

- Proactively assist in defining the direction for future IT Products, services and validate product designs;

- Participate in all phases of the application development life cycle which includes integration, validation and production;

- Align architecture strategy with the organisation business goals;

- Define policies, standards and guidelines that direct the selection, development implementation and use of Information Technology within the organisation;

- Project management, involving gathering requirements, creating technical specifications and architecture documents, creating and maintaining documentation and managing a project timeline.

During this time, you will also get to work with various teams in our engineering, design, quality, operations support, cyber security, IT solutions and helpdesk teams and our supply chain and logistics departments, whilst also having the opportunity to pick placements outside of your area of study, including HR, facilities management, recruitment, finance and much more.

Requirements:

This is an ideal role for someone with a keen interest in ICT, digital technology, internet of things, mobile apps, data analytics and future tech.

In order to be eligible for this apprenticeship you must have a minimum:

- 3 A-Levels as grade C/4 or above, preferably in Maths, Sciences and IT;

OR

- T Level in an IT/Digital subject at Merit or above;

OR

- BTEC L3 Extended Diploma in an IT/Digital subject, at minimum MMM grade;

OR

- Equivalent qualifications/Experience subject to validation;

AND

- Minimum of 4 GCSEs including English Language and Maths – Grade 4/C or above.

**Please note that, due to the funded nature of this programme, applicants with undergraduate degrees in computing/IT are not eligible.

Successful candidates should demonstrate the following:

- Submit your CV stating your grades and if they are predicted or achieved;
- Submit a Cover Letter stating your motivations;
- The ability to work well in a team, as well as focus on your own self development;
- Experience or knowledge of IT product design and development;
- Ability to manage problems, produce documentation, and complete testing;
- Knowledge of Information and knowledge management, and component integration;
- Experience with computer languages such as C++, JavaScript, Python would be beneficial.

BOOST YOUR APPLICATION:

We want to get to know you—not just your grades or school background so, tell us on your cover letter:

- Why Airbus and this apprenticeship?
What is it about Airbus that makes you excited to start a career with us? What is it about our company, our values, or the future of aerospace that excites you? We want to hear about what motivates you to pursue this unique path and how you see yourself growing with us.

- What skills and experience do you bring?
Think about projects, hobbies, or academic subjects that have given you practical experience. This could include personal projects, academic work and extracurricular activities. ​

Important Information:

GRADES: If you are on predicted grades, your offer will be conditional to achieving the position’s requirements before the apprenticeship start date.

SECURITY CLEARANCE: You will be subject to a BPSS (Baseline Personnel Security Standard) check. You may also need to gain UK SC-level Security Clearance or Export Control, depending on the role.

RIGHT TO WORK IN THE UK: Candidates must have current legal authorisation to work in the United Kingdom for the full duration of the programme. For more information, please check the Government Website.

LEVY FUNDING: Successful candidates must be eligible for the levy funding.

Our apprenticeship roles do not meet the minimum requirements set by UK Visas & Immigration to enable sponsorship of migrant workers.

Please let us know if you need us to make any adjustments to allow you to access and participate fully in the recruitment process. If you wish to discuss this further please contact via email apprentices@airbus.com​. ​ ​Any information disclosed will be treated in the strictest confidence.

Job Description:

Airbus Aerosystems Kinston is looking for a Digital Finance Product Manager to join our team based in Kinston, NC

This is a critical digital role within our newly established Digital team in Kinston, instrumental in ensuring end to end stability and performance of our Digital Finance Solution with a primary focus on ERP (SAP) solution. You'll be the on-site digital representative for the digital finance solutions providing a vital link between our local Kinston site and the central ERP Centre of Excellence (CoE) for all these subjects.

Initially, you will be the Digital Finance leader to ensure the deployment of our digital finance solutions (local & central) to the Kinston site and facilitate the move to the end state finalizing the transition to Airbus. This means looking beyond the immediate transition, understanding the bigger picture, being familiar with the strategy and the different digital finance solutions, and supporting decisions that align with our long-term objectives. Beyond this, you'll play a crucial role to ensure overall consistency and ensure the Digital Finance solutions are maintained by anticipating evolutions needed.

In the meantime, this role will support the creation and stabilization of a small Digital Finance team in the North America Region in order to be able to face current and future challenges.

This position offers a unique opportunity to play a key role for Digital Finance in North America, supporting immediate key projects and activities, and contributing strategically to the success of our manufacturing ramp-up in a dynamic environment undergoing significant transformation in the North America Region.

.Meet the Team:
Our team at Airbus Aerosystems Kinston manufactures crucial aircraft components. On the shop floor you’ll be surrounded by individuals who are passionate about aviation and skilled in areas like electrical, structure and quality. Join our team and help build the next generation of aircraft.

Your Working Environment:
The Airbus Aerosystems Kinston facility sits at the forefront of aerospace manufacturing, specializing in the production of large, advanced composite aerostructures. Our team builds critical components for the state-of-the-art Airbus A350 XWB, including the composite center fuselage and wing spar.

How We Care for You:

- Financial Rewards: Competitive pay, incentive compensation which may include profit sharing schemes, retirement savings plan and the ability to participate in an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (“ESOP”)
- Work/Life Balance: Paid time off including personal time, holidays and a paid parental leave program.

- Individual Development: Upskilling and development opportunities through our global Leadership University, including unlimited access to 10,000+ e-learning courses focusing on ways to develop your employability, certifications, career path; as well as the opportunity to participate in accelerated development programmes; and both national and international mobility.

Your Challenges:

Manage and lead the transition period from an overall Digital Finance perspective: 40%

- Ensure services delivered from existing suppliers are in line with the current contracts to secure the day to day activities. (bugs / defects resolution as per TSA) until the transition to the end state is secured.

- Anticipate, Advice & Secure on potential mandatory small evolutions / change requests of the As-Is solutions with the existing suppliers being and remaining compliant / efficient.

- Develop deep understanding of the As-Is solutions (end to end) with processes associated to ease the transition to the Digital Finance central and local solutions.

- Be the focal point between Kinston local teams and the central SAP ERP CoE (Finance), ensuring effective communication and alignment on Finance solutions.

- Gather and anticipate local and legal requirements / specificities and liaise with local/central teams.

Manage the end state deployments: 30%

- Together with the Digital regional Domains, being fully responsible and accountable for the Digital Operations service performance of the local site

- Supply Chain: In alignment with regional & global sourcing strategies: drive the suppliers activities related to Digital Operations solutions and services, track the suppliers performance for any deliveries for Operations, may it be for project or for run activities

Manage and secure efficiency and reliability after the end state deployment : 15%

- Change: define and lead the change management / plant adoption and implementation of the Digital solutions being delivered to the Operations at plant level, whichever team, function, Airbus entity or external supplier delivers them.

[After full securitization of the 3 main missions above], act as the key stakeholder to secure Digital Finance in the Region

- Steer the creation and stabilization of the Digital Finance Activities with Central Digital Finance Team in Europe

- Steer & secure with Digital North America the local Digital finance activities

- Ensure that overall application portfolio is maintained and secured end to end on Digital side

- Steer the Digital strategy definition for Finance (3y & 5y) for local and central applications ensuring alignment with the central team.

- Minimum 5 years experience working with and supporting Service Now and Integrated Tools

Operating at the intersection of operational teams and Executive Leadership, you will lead early-phase digital evaluation and integration strategy, aligning regional deal execution with global Airbus standards and multi-million-dollar deal objectives.

Meet the Team:

You will belong to the DM for Digital Corporate & Analytics domain within Digital & Information Management (IM) North America, working in close collaboration and with operational reporting alignment to the European DMTM | Digital for Mergers & Acquisitions team. You will serve as a vital dual-interface connecting operational site leads, European HQ M&A leads, external advisors, and Executive Vice Presidents/Steering Committees across cross-border transactions.

Located just outside Washington, D.C., Herndon is a thriving technology and aerospace hub in Northern Virginia. Positioned minutes from Washington Dulles International Airport, it offers exceptional global connectivity, top-tier school districts, and convenient access to the rich cultural, historical, and dining scenes of the capital region, alongside the scenic outdoor landscapes of the Blue Ridge Mountains and Shenandoah Valley.

How We Care for You:

- Financial Rewards: Competitive base salary, incentive compensation which may include profit-sharing schemes, retirement savings plan with company match, and the opportunity to participate in the Airbus Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP).
- Work/Life Balance: Generous paid time off including personal time, company holidays, flexible working arrangements, and a comprehensive paid parental leave program.

- Lead Pre-Deal IT Due Diligence & Risk Evaluations: Direct technical due diligence, target architecture assessments, cybersecurity risk evaluations, and legacy technical debt identification for M&A projects, joint ventures, and divestitures across North America.

- Drive Deal Financial Governance: Steer IT financial valuation support, including pre-deal budget modeling, synergy target estimation, Transition Service Agreement (TSA) cost scoping, and advisory/consultancy spend governance.
- Execute Regional Post-Merger Integrations (PMI): Direct post-merger integration and corporate separation activities across North American entities (US and Canada), overseeing software cutovers, cloud migrations, data governance, and Day 1/Day 2 stabilization according to global Airbus standards.

- Maintain Executive & Regional Alignment: Act as the operational interface between North American site leadership, IM pillars, and Executive Vice Presidents to secure buy-in throughout deal handoffs.

- 10+ years of progressive IS/IT Project/Program Management experience, with a proven track record leading IT workstreams in M&A, PMI, corporate restructurings, carve-outs, or company creation across international, multi-entity setups.
- Demonstrated experience managing multi-million-dollar program budgets, vendor contracts, and TSA financial management structures.
- In-depth technical breadth across enterprise application suites, cloud infrastructure environments (AWS/Azure), data migration tools, and modern delivery frameworks (Agile/Waterfall).
- Strong exposure to customer-facing systems, Customer Support/Services operations, and client-relationship considerations during integration.
- Outstanding executive presentation, negotiation, and cross-cultural communication skills in English; ability to influence senior stakeholders across multiple time zones.

- Prior experience within aerospace/defense, Customer Support & Services, or familiarity with the Airbus Information Management (IM) ecosystem is an asset.

- Frequent high-level involved, influencing, and executive-level negotiating communications with internal European M&A leads, Executive Steering Committees (EVPs/C-suite), external advisory partners, and key commercial/defense customer representatives.

Job Description:

DIGITAL SECURITY MANAGEMENT

The Digital Security Manager is responsible for overseeing and driving digital security operations for Airbus and all its divisions and affiliates in China, including the Commercial Aircraft, Defence & Space, and Helicopters divisions divisions.

The job holder is responsible for overseeing and driving digital security operations across China, encompassing:

- Implementation of the corporate digital security strategy within business operations

- Industrial digital security activities

- Digital security risk identification and mitigation

- Support for digital security audits, technical evaluations, and compliance frameworks

- Support for the HR secure hiring process

- Contributions to threat intelligence

- On-demand support for technical legal investigations

- Data Leakage Prevention (DLP) management

- Support to digital security training and awareness programs

- Support security evaluations during the procurement call for tender (CFT) selection process

Main activities

Strategic activities

- Support the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) in deploying corporate digital security initiatives

- Coordinate and facilitate local digital security initiatives and programs across China

- Identify, consolidate, and manage digital security risks and their corresponding response plans in China

- Assist the CISO in drafting, validating, and publishing digital security policies, processes, and position papers

Client-related activities

- Interface directly with local business units on digital security topics

- Liaise closely with the IM Cybersecurity team regarding operational controls and initiatives

Operational activities

- Ensure absolute compliance with Corporate and Divisional digital security requirements and standards

- Provide dedicated security support for products, services, and ongoing projects

- Provide guidance, formal responses, and validation for digital security requests and queries

- Contribute to security awareness by designing, organizing, and delivering educational materials and training sessions

- Manage digital risks through comprehensive identification, assessment, reporting, and remediation follow-ups

- Ensure thorough vulnerability management and follow-up across all corporate IT and Operational Technology (OT) assets

- Support technical legal investigations and forensic laboratory activities on-demand

- Coordinate and support technical digital security technical evaluations

- Coordinate and support audits and regulatory compliance initiatives (e.g., ISO27001, PART-IS, etc.)

- Implement localized digital security projects and strategic initiatives

- Scout new and emerging technologies that enhance the digital security posture

- Support on-demand security screening of candidates, including establishing, formalizing, and maintaining comprehensive screening processes, tools, and methodologies

- Contribute to and proactively anticipate threat intelligence

- Continuously improve the precision and response capabilities of Data Leakage Prevention (DLP) information

- Evaluate vendor security postures within procurement processes to support business selection

- Execute other tasks as assigned by the CISO

Outputs

Financial Outputs

N/A

Client-related Outputs

- Ensure that all business activities remain fully compliant with corporate security policies and standards

- Supervision of IM cybersecurity operational compliance KPIs to ensure they consistently meet targets

Operational Outputs

- Achievement of yearly operational objectives

- Delivery of high-quality, timely security support to the business

- Maintenance of an accurate digital security risk exposure map and corresponding action plans

- On-demand technical support for specific legal investigations

- Timely completion and follow-up of technical evaluations

- High-quality, timely execution of candidate screening

- Precise and responsive DLP detection and mitigation

- Rigorous security assessments for the CFT process

Skills & Experience

Education & Professional Qualifications

- Academic Background: Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field

- Certifications: possessing professional certifications or framework-specific certifications (e.g., ISO 27001) are a strong plus

Knowledge & Experience

Im dualen Studium Informatik befasst du dich mit der systematischen Analyse, Gestaltung, Implementierung und Pflege von Softwaresystemen, die auf eine lange Lebenszeit angelegt sind. Im Studienschwerpunkt “IT Security” werden die folgenden Themenfelder behandelt: IT-Recht, IT Security, Design sicherer Systeme, Sichere Produktionssysteme, Data Security, Cloud Computing, Funknetze, Netzarchitekturen, Sichere Unternehmensnetze, Angriffsmethoden, Penetration Testing, Angewandte Informatikforschung.

Dein Standort

Zwischen Stuttgart und München gelegen, ist Ulm eine Stadt, die ein breites Spektrum an Freizeit- und Kulturangeboten bietet. Hier kannst du die Lebensqualität unter dem höchsten Kirchturm der Welt genießen und Teil einer Stadt sein, die sowohl ihre historischen Sehenswürdigkeiten bewahrt, als auch die Zukunft entlang der Donau aktiv gestaltet.

Unser Portfolio reicht in der Informatik von der klassischen Desktop Entwicklung bis hin zur Roboterarm-Programmierung, sowie in der Elektrotechnik bis hin zur Entwicklung und Fertigung eigener elektronischer Platinen. Knapp 1.150 Mitarbeitende in 17 Ländern realisieren die Planung, den Aufbau und den Betrieb unserer Mobilfunknetze. Die Verfügbarkeit und Zuverlässigkeit unserer Netze ist dabei Industrie-Benchmark.

title: Embedded Software Engineer
description:
Job Description:

An opportunity for a Embedded Software Engineer has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space, Getafe (Madrid).

Our world is changing. And so are we. From our commitment to zero-carbon flight (#ZEROe) to cleaning up space, sustainability is at the heart of our purpose. So what's your next change?

Our team, “Airborne Connectivity” is part of the engineering function in Airbus Defence and Space, designing and developing products, hardware and software, providing connectivity and communications capabilities to our customers. These products are integrated as part of the solutions provided by two out of the three main programme lines in Airbus Defence and Space, Secure Communications in Connected Intelligence, and all military airborne platforms in Military Air Systems (Eurofighter, C295, MRTT, SIRTAP, Eurodrone, etc.)

Be part of the future by making the next generation of high-integrity airborne real-time systems, paving the way for innovation in smart connectivity, distributed networking, and artificial intelligence adoption. You will take part in a high performance team that is involved in the complete lifecycle of the embedded software product, from building the SW requirements, to the final testing and target computer implementation. You should be able to lead and take responsibility on design/architectural decisions, as well as leading the development of specific projects.

TRAVEL REQUIRED: Occasional travel within national and international areas (around 3-day trip).

HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE TO THE TEAM:

- Work across all the levels of embedded software development according to specific SW standards (SW requirements, SW design, SW coding, SW verification, SW configuration, SW documentation release, SW change management and support to SW QA).
- Partner with product & program managers, system engineers and validation teams to drive software products.
- Participate in the planning and scope for the team projects.
- Support product owners and project managers to deliver high quality software on time.
- Promote innovation across the department.

ABOUT YOU:

Required skills and qualifications:

- Educated in software, IT, telecommunication, industrial engineering degree or a related discipline.
- Expertise on real-time and/or embedded software development.
- Expertise on defining SW requirements.
- Expertise on C/C++ and/or Ada programming languages and low-level development.
- Expertise on software verification.
- +3 years of experience
- Fluent level of English and Spanish.

Preferred skills and qualifications:

- Knowledge of SW airworthiness certification processes: DO-178C, EFA Standards.
- Awareness of cyber-security concepts and accreditation processes (Common Criteria).
- Experience on: system & SW design tools (SysML, UML), integrated development environment (GPS, AdaMulti, Eclipse), verification tools (Vector Cast, AdaTest95).
- Interest and ability to conciliate multiple perspectives regarding products, projects and processes.

At Airbus we are focused on our employees and their welfare. Take a look at some of our social benefits:

- Vacation days plus additional days-off along the year.
- Attractive salary.
- Hybrid model of working when possible, promoting the work-life balance.
- Collective transport service subject to working calendar/home location.
- Benefits such as life insurance, health insurance, employee stock options, retirement plan, or study grants.

- Possibility to collaborate in different social and corporate social responsibility initiatives.
- Excellent upskilling opportunities and great development prospects in a multicultural environment.
- Option to access special rates in products & benefits.

title: GRC Cyber Security Consultant
description:
Job Description:

Company Statement

Airbus Protect is a wholly owned subsidiary of Airbus Group. We are a risk management leader in safety, cybersecurity and sustainability.

We protect businesses and products from end-to-end, going beyond mere compliance to strengthen incident prevention and resilience at every level.

The Role

As a Cyber Security Consultant at Airbus Protect, you will act as a trusted advisor to our clients, delivering expert guidance across a diverse range of sectors. This is a multi-faceted role designed for someone who can help our customers navigate the increasingly complex threat and regulatory landscapes. You will be navigating both tactical and technical compliance challenges alongside high-level strategic risk management.

Due to the sensitive nature of the projects we deliver for our clients, it is an essential requirement that you currently hold, or meet the criteria to obtain, UK Government Security Clearance. This foundational requirement goes hand-in-hand with our need for a proven track record in cyber security consulting. We expect your practical experience navigating complex GRC challenges to be firmly underpinned by recognised industry certifications—such as CISSP, CISM, or ISO 27001—demonstrating your established capability to advise clients with authority and technical rigor.

Key Responsibilities may include:

Governance

- Strategic Consulting: Advise clients on sound security architecture principles, including Secure by Design, network segmentation, and zero-trust frameworks, ensuring technical solutions align with business priorities.
- Technical Advisory: Lead engagements on specialised areas providing both high-level strategy and technical oversight. Providing consultancy on complex technical topics such as IDAM, PAM, and DLP, translating these into clear, actionable business advice.
- Regulatory Guidance: Advise and assure compliance against current and emerging frameworks/standards and regulations such as ISO27001, ISA/IEC62443, NIST CSF, NIST 800-53, NCSC CAF, NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act, the AI Act, EASA Part-IS.
- AI Integration: Leverage AI tools to optimise internal delivery while consulting customers on the secure adoption and governance of AI within their own environments and in regulatory compliance.
- Multi-Project Leadership: Efficiently manage and execute multiple client engagements simultaneously, prioritising deliverables, driving project timelines, and consistently delivering quality consulting outputs while maintaining strong customer relationships across various industry sectors.

Risk

- Risk Management: Produce high-quality risk assessments and assurance artefacts across the full system lifecycle, tailoring your approach to the client’s specific business context, including consideration of technical and human factors.
- Risk Mitigation & Guidance: Translate technical gaps and architectural risks into prioritised, actionable remediation plans, advising delivery teams and business stakeholders on achieving compliance and long-term cyber resilience.
- Gap assessment: Conduct comprehensive gap assessments against relevant cybersecurity standards, frameworks, and regulations (e.g., ISO27001, ISA/IEC62443, NIST CSF, NIST 800-53, NCSC CAF, NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act, the AI Act, EASA Part-IS) to evaluate client security postures, identify control deficiencies, and deliver prioritised, actionable remediation roadmaps that guide clients toward full compliance readiness.

Compliance

- Cyber Resilience: Devise and test strategies that ensure clients can withstand and respond to cyber incidents.
- Secure Design & Baseline Assurance: Evaluate system architectures and technical configurations against established security baselines and Secure by Design principles. Identify design and configuration vulnerabilities early in the delivery lifecycle, providing actionable recommendations to guide customers toward secure, resilient, and compliant solutions.

Supporting New Business:

Beyond technical delivery, you will play a supporting role in the growth and market presence of Airbus Protect:

- Content Creation: Authoring technical blogs, white papers, and insights on emerging security trends to enhance our brand authority.
- Sales and Marketing Support: Support to Sales and Marketing colleagues with technical representation at customer and marketing events. Developing compelling case studies and service descriptions aligned with our services portfolio. Representing Airbus at webinars, industry panels, and conferences to showcase our expertise.
- Business Development: Active participation in the bid process and supporting ongoing customer relationship management to identify new opportunities.

The Individual

We are seeking a proactive self-starter capable of taking a forward-looking approach to understanding customer requirements by providing effective inputs that add tangible benefit to the customer’s business.

Essential Requirements:

- Experience: 5–10 years of experience in a cyber security consulting or technical leadership role
- Clearance: Must hold, or have the ability to obtain, UK Government Security Clearance.
- Qualifications: At least one of the following certifications (CISSP, CISM, CCSP, CISA, ISO 27001, GICSP, ISA62443) or equivalents.
- Frameworks and Standards: Demonstrable experience of regulatory compliance and Standards adherence.
- Mindset: A self-starter who stays ahead of the curve on threat intelligence and industry best practices.
- Communication: Exceptional presentation skills; able to communicate complex technical topics to non-technical stakeholders.
- Collaboration: Proven ability to work autonomously while contributing effectively to multiple virtual and transnational teams and customers across concurrent projects.
- AI Literacy: Demonstrable understanding of how to use AI tools for productivity and the principles of securing AI environments.
- Business Acumen: Demonstrable evidence of business support benefits undertaken and realised
- Mobility: Full UK Driving Licence.
- Locality: Whilst this is a Hybrid Role, you will be expected to be in our Bristol office for at least 2-3 days a week.

Remuneration & Benefits

- Competitive Salary
- Annual profit share scheme.
- Comprehensive company benefits and private healthcare options consistent with a market-leading transnational organisation.

Step into a role where your cyber security expertise directly safeguards the future of aerospace and satellite technology.

At our Airbus Defence and Space site in Corsham, we are seeking a highly credentialed Ground System Security Design Engineer to provide end-to-end protection for our critical Spacecraft Control Centre Systems and Satellite Communications infrastructures.

Reporting to the Head of SCOF Engineering you will play a pivotal role in managing high-stakes security architecture and ensuring our defenses remain ahead of evolving threats.

HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE TO THE TEAM

As a key player in our security infrastructure, you will take ownership of complex risks and coordinate comprehensive defense strategies. In this role, you will:

- Provide end-to-end support to projects with regards to cyber security.

- Analyze functional needs, establish associated criticality levels, propose appropriate security protection concepts, and project and manage risks for the project.

- Maintain state-of-the-art knowledge of standards, regulation, governance, and best practices across specified disciplines.

- Manage end-to-end projects, tasks, and deliverables in accordance with Airbus Business Processes.

- Ensure the activity of all actors and disciplines is coordinated and fits together in the overall security architecture.

- Leverage your knowledge and understanding of Spacecraft Control Centre Systems to ensure robust protection.

- Apply your knowledge of Satellite Communications infrastructures to secure critical data streams.

ABOUT YOU

We are looking for a dedicated professional who thrives in a highly secure environment and possesses a deep understanding of complex operating systems and network infrastructures. To succeed in this role, you will bring:

- CISSP Accreditation

- CISM Accreditation

- Proven experience working within a Secure environment

- Demonstrable knowledge of Solaris, Linux, and Windows Operating Systems

Airbus is a global leader in aeronautics, space and related services. In 2016, it generated revenues of € 67 billion and employed a workforce of around 134,000. Airbus offers the most comprehensive range of passenger airliners from 100 to more than 600 seats. Airbus is also a European leader providing tanker, combat, transport and mission aircraft, as well as Europe's number one space enterprise and the world's second largest space business. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions worldwide.

Our people work with passion and determination to make the world a more connected, safer and smarter place. Our diversity and teamwork culture propel us to accomplish the extraordinary – on the ground, in the sky and in space.

As an apprentice you will be trained in high grade cryptographic development, you will learn about our existing Ectocryp and CertSecure suite of products. You will join a team of highly skilled team of engineers working to deliver the next generation of encryption devices. You will receive on the job training and a formal degree qualification all while being paid and accruing no course fees.

title: Head of Business Continuity Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Job Description:

Job Description

As a Business Continuity Manager Germany, you will be a strategic leader responsible for establishing and driving our Business Continuity Management (BCM) program in one of our key markets. Reporting to senior leadership and working closely with our global colleagues and divisional stakeholders, you will ensure that our operations remain resilient and our risks are proactively managed. Your role will be critical in protecting our assets, reputation and overall business stability through effective planning, training and incident management.

Accountabilities

- The jobholder is fully accountable for the strategic design, greenfield establishment, and sustained excellence of the Business Continuity Management (BCM) programme across the ADS Division's designated countries (in the country assigned to this position), where no prior formal BCM system exists. This encompasses leadership over all key BCM processes, including rigorous Business Impact Analyses (BIAs), the development of comprehensive continuity plans, and serving as the designated National BCM Risk Owner with full delegated authority for integrating all threat and vulnerability assessments into the Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) framework. A critical part of this accountability is the successful achievement and ongoing maintenance of the ISO 22301 certification, ensuring full compliance with both internal and international BCM standards.
- Furthermore, the position is accountable for driving organisational BCM readiness by designing and executing comprehensive, scenario-based training and exercises for all staff levels. This includes the direct management and oversight of external teams/vendors critical to the BCM deployment and ongoing operations. The jobholder must leverage interdisciplinary expertise to deeply understand and integrate the specific needs of all major business functions, and must provide expert tactical support during real-world incidents, followed by thorough post-incident evaluations to ensure continuous program improvement.
- If the Business Continuity Manager fails to perform their duties effectively, or if the position remains vacant, the organisation risks being ill-prepared to respond to significant disruptions such as cyber incidents, natural disasters, or supply chain breakdowns. This could result in prolonged operational downtime, the loss of critical data, failure to meet contractual or regulatory obligations, and serious financial and reputational damage. Within a highly regulated and security-sensitive industry such as defence and space, such shortcomings could further undermine national security commitments, erode stakeholder confidence, and expose the organisation to legal or governmental sanctions.

Dimensions

- The jobholder is responsible for the strategic vendor selection, contract management, and oversight of BCM-related external sub-contracted services and vendors. The role has a P&L influence through direct management of the Operating Budget.

Main Activities

- The main activities center on defining and driving the multi-year BCM roadmap and leading the end-to-end transformation of BCM from a nascent state to a mature, certified program across multiple international sites. This is achieved by defining and implementing the overarching BCM strategy, developing the foundational policies and procedures, and ensuring their strict alignment with the global divisional framework.
- A key deliverable is the continuous elevation of the organisation's readiness level through the design and delivery of a mandatory training curriculum and the execution of high-fidelity, cross-functional simulation exercises. These activities drive value by systematically reducing business interruption risk and ensuring a swift, coordinated response to any crisis scenario.
- The jobholder's impact is also seen in the management of complex external vendor relationships and cross-functional teams to deploy digital BCM tools and ensure all Business Impact Analyses are rooted in a deep, interdisciplinary understanding of the entire ADS Division's operations. This value creation is essential for protecting the company's assets and reputation.

Outputs

- The primary output is a fully operational, ISO 22301-certified Business Continuity Management System in the designated country, transitioning from a greenfield status to a mature, auditable program compliant with all regulatory and corporate standards. This output includes a suite of validated BCM documentation.
- A critical output is the generation of a robust BCM Risk Profile for the country, derived from comprehensive threat and vulnerability assessments, which is formally integrated and reported as part of the Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) process.
- The role delivers a measurable increase in organisational resilience and preparedness, evidenced by post-exercise reports, lower recovery times, and a highly engaged staff culture achieved through a structured and successful annual BCM training and exercise program.

Key Requirements

Work Experience

- Depth of Experience: Minimum of 5-7 years' experience in Business Continuity Management, Risk Management, or a related field.
- Program Management: Proven track record of successfully implementing and managing comprehensive, country-level Business Continuity programs and plans.
- Implementation & Oversight: Direct experience in conducting Business Impact Analyses (BIAs) and developing localized BC plans for critical business units.
- Team & Project Leadership: Experience in leading or mentoring a small local team or managing cross-functional project teams within a single country or business unit.
- Language Skills (Mandatory): Fluent in both German and English (written and spoken) is required, as this role manages local regulatory/operational stakeholders in Germany while coordinating with global teams.

Core Competencies

- Analytical & Implementation Skills: Strong analytical skills with a practical understanding of business risk assessments and the execution of BCM policies.
- BCM Execution: Ability to successfully implement and monitor BC plans and governance structures at the country level.
- Project Management: Strong project management skills necessary to drive collaboration across local functions and departments.
- Communication: Strong communication skills, able to effectively liaise with local and regional management, technical teams, and relevant country-level stakeholders.
- Adaptability: Ability to manage complex projects and adapt quickly to evolving local risks and regulatory changes.

Educational Background & Certifications

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Risk Management, or a related field is required.
- Certifications (Preferred): Relevant certifications such as ISO 22301 Lead Implementer, ISO 27001, or equivalent.

Additional Attributes

- A proactive mindset with a focus on continuous improvement in local operational resilience.
- Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage resource allocation effectively.

● The products and means used to communicate with the customer during the delivery of the aircraft that he is purchasing: Invitations, Orientation during visits in Plant/FAL,Technical Status, Request of Rework, planning dates, ...relying on the data which are managed within other Business Products
● The product & tools used to measure & drumbeat the progress of the Aircraft from end of manufacturing to delivery of the Aircraft: prioritization of Aircraft, Live technical status, escalation of critical Items, allocation/management of teams, efficiency of Actors
● The preparation & execution of the tests of the aircrafts on production Aircrafts: Noise detection, scheduling of flights, preparation of flights
Within the Digital & IM organization, we are seeking a highly experienced and passionate IT / Application Architect specializing in RedHat OpenShift (OCP 4) to join our team in Bangalore, India. You will play a pivotal role in designing, architecting, and modernizing cloud-native microservices, hybrid container platforms, and edge/PWA application topologies.
In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional Agile teams, enterprise architects, and engineering leads to deliver secure, resilient, and high-performing enterprise application solutions.

Qualifications & Experience
● Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
● Experience: 10 - 14+ years of total IT experience with at least 5–8 years of experience designing, architecting, and operating complex enterprise applications and containerized platform topologies.
● Agile Expertise: Minimum 2-3 years working in cross-functional Agile/SAFe or Scrum teams from inception through release.
● Language: Advanced proficiency in English (verbal and written).

Technical Skills & Requirements
1. Platform & Runtime Architecture
● RedHat OpenShift (OCP 4): Extensive hands-on design and architecture experience scaling cluster states across OCP namespaces, optimizing Horizontal Pod Autoscalers (HPA), and configuring Pod Disruption Budgets (PDB).
● RedHat Source-to-Image (S2I): Proven ability to manage production artifact builds leveraging RedHat Universal Base Images (UBI9).
● Runtimes & Servers: Deep architectural knowledge of Java (OpenJDK 17, Spring, Quarkus) for microservices and batch systems, NodeJS 24 / ReactJS / Redux for front-end platforms, as well as Apache HTTPd 2.4 & Tomcat 10 for reverse proxying, valve logging, and runtime baselines.

2. System Design & Edge / PWA Topology
● Local-First Storage Patterns: Capability to architect high-availability offline-capable web apps using browser-based storage patterns (IndexedDB).
● Offline Data Synchronization: Design offline action capture to perform synchronization through replay-mode, validating operations using cryptographic signatures
● Layered Gateway Topologies & APIs: Building decoupled API fabrics and API Gateways to govern curated internal datasets safely out to consumer boundaries.

3. DevSecOps, Identity & Compliance
● Federated Identity & SSO: Expertise in managing enterprise Single Sign-On (SSO) bridges, OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect (OIDC) over MobileSSO for both user (U2M) and machine (M2M) authentication.
● Peer-to-Peer Cryptography: Implementing cross-component token isolation utilizing signed and encrypted JSON Web Encryption (JWE) tokens via custom key configurations.
● Logical Export Controls: Implementing logical workspace borders separating restricted datasets (e.g., military ITAR data) based on contextual program variables.
● Segregated Audit Logging: Design dedicated log routing and indexing to maintain secure audit trails separate from standard application operational logs.

4. CI/CD & Automation
● Ansible Automation Platform: Writing infrastructure-as-code playbooks and managing cluster credentials securely via Ansible Vault.
● Pipeline Engineering: Constructing automated multi-stage compilation workflows using Jenkins pipelines integrated with enterprise GitHub repositories.
● DevSecOps Integration: Injecting static security inspection tools (SonarQube, CheckmarxOne, DefectDojo) into routine CI/CD pipelines.

5. Data & Core Infrastructure
● Oracle DB Topology: Configuring high-availability SQL*Net database connections targeting remote Oracle virtual instances bound to active Data Guard pools.
● Multi-Protocol Volumes: Mounting cluster-external network file spaces utilizing SFTP, NFS v4, or SMB/CIFS combined with active Kerberos validation.
● Perimeter Firewalls & Proxies: Designing and monitoring data pipelines traversing Data Center Filtering (DCF) firewalls and AxessGate proxy publication pathways.

description:

Job Description:

Are you a Network Engineer who thrives when the "data center" is a tactical field rig, a Starlink dish, and a multi-hop RF relay?

Airbus is looking for a hands-on Network Engineer to own the stability, security, and real-time diagnostics of the communications linking our Unmanned Aircraft Systems (UAS) to ground control stations. In this high-impact role, you won't just be managing routine server racks—you’ll be engineering resilient VPN, firewall, and wireless architectures across Linux and Windows devices operating in unpredictable field environments.

If you bring a background in tactical/expeditionary communications, WISP field networking, or remote SCADA environments—and enjoy designing systems that don't break far from a help desk—we want to hear from you. Help us shape the future of autonomous flight connectivity!

Meet the Team:

The Airbus Helicopters Flexrotor Program offers one of the most sophisticated small tactical unmanned aerial systems (STUAS) with vertical take-off and landing (VTOL). It can be used day or night by US and allied forces for a diverse range of intelligence, surveillance, target acquisition and reconnaissance (ISTAR) on land and at sea.

Your Working Environment:
Nestled in the heart of the spectacular Columbia River Gorge in Bingen, WA, our workplace offers innovation and the ability to contribute to game-changing solutions while enjoying the flexibility to spread your wings. Whether it's solving complex challenges, or celebrating victories, you’ll be part of a cohesive crew that thrives on innovation and the beauty that the Northwest has to offer!

How We Care for You:

- Financial Rewards: Competitive base salary, incentive compensation which may include profit sharing schemes, retirement savings plan and the ability to participate in an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (“ESOP”)

- Work/Life Balance: Paid time off including personal time, holidays and a generous paid parental leave program.

- Health & Welfare: Comprehensive insurance coverage including medical (traditional and high-deductible health plans), prescription, dental, vision, life, disability, Employee Assistance Plan (“EAP”) and other supplemental benefit coverages.

Your Challenges:

Network Architecture & Infrastructure Engineering: 35%

- Lead the design and evolution of network architecture across VPNs, firewalls, RF relays, Starlink links, and Ground Control Station (GCS) connectivity as deployments scale to a larger fleet.

- Configure and maintain VPN servers and clients, firewalls, routing, and related network services across mixed Windows and Linux environments.

- Design network architecture for scalability, ensuring configurations, infrastructure, and deployment approaches remain repeatable and maintainable as the fleet grows.

- Collect, manage, and route data flows between field-deployed UAS/GCS systems and home-base or office infrastructure.

- Maintain network topology documentation, interface definitions, and configuration standards across GCS variants and deployment sites.

Network Operations, Monitoring & Field Support: 35%

- Diagnose and resolve network issues including degraded or intermittent RF and satellite links, interference, obstruction, latency, packet loss, routing, and connectivity problems, primarily through remote troubleshooting.

- Establish network monitoring, logging, alerting, and health-check capabilities to identify and surface network issues proactively.

- Build, or partner with Software Engineering to develop, diagnostic tools and dashboards that provide operators with clear and actionable visibility into network health.

- Serve as the technical escalation point for network issues beyond operator or first-line troubleshooting capability.

- Provide occasional in-field support for complex network or communications issues that cannot be resolved remotely.

- Identify recurring network failure modes, perform root-cause analysis, and implement corrective actions that improve system reliability and reduce operator IT support burden.

Cybersecurity, Standardization & Operational Resilience: 30%

- Apply secure network design practices including network segmentation, secure remote access, VPN/encryption, firewall configuration, authentication, and access control across UAS and ground network infrastructure.

- Configure and harden Windows, Linux, VPN, firewall, and other network devices using established security baselines and configuration-control practices.

- Support vulnerability identification and remediation, security logging and monitoring, patching, and network security improvements across deployed systems.

- Develop and maintain standard operating procedures, secure configuration standards, troubleshooting guides, and operator documentation that enable field personnel to resolve common issues without requiring deep networking expertise.

- Ensure cybersecurity, network configurations, monitoring capabilities, and documentation remain standardized and maintainable across GCS variants and deployment locations.

Your Boarding Pass: (Required for consideration)

- Must possess a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

- Have a minimum of five (5) years of experience in network engineering, systems administration, or field communications, with direct, hands-on responsibility for network stability and troubleshooting (not primarily help-desk/tier-1 support).

- Demonstrated experience configuring and troubleshooting VPNs, firewalls, and routing across both Windows and Linux environments.

- Experience with wireless/RF networking and satellite communications (e.g., Starlink, VSAT, or similar), including working with degraded, intermittent, or high-latency links.

- Experience designing or scaling network architectures, not solely maintaining existing ones — you'll be shaping how our networks evolve as we grow.

- Scripting or automation experience (PowerShell and/or Python) sufficient to build basic diagnostic tools and health checks, or to partner effectively with a software engineering team on more complex tooling.

- Demonstrated ability to stabilize and improve an existing, imperfect network environment rather than only building greenfield systems.

- Strong working knowledge of TCP/IP networking fundamentals: routing, subnetting, NAT, DNS, DHCP.

- Proficiency configuring and troubleshooting VPNs (e.g., n2n or similar peer-to-peer/supernode-based VPN architectures), firewalls, and network security policies.

- VPN technology: n2n (or similar peer-to-peer/supernode VPN).

- Firewall platforms: pfSense, iptables/nftables, Windows Defender Firewall/advanced security (or equivalents).

Preferred Skills:

- Experience operating in field, remote, or expeditionary environments — tactical communications, WISP field networking, industrial/SCADA remote-site networking, or similar.

- Experience supporting non-technical end users (operators) in troubleshooting network issues, with an eye toward simplifying and self-service enablement.

- Experience securing field-deployed, tactical, aerospace, or defense networks, including VPNs, firewalls, encrypted communications, network segmentation, and secure remote access.

- Familiarity with DoD cybersecurity practices such as RMF, NIST SP 800-53, and DISA STIGs as they relate to network infrastructure and system hardening.

- Experience supporting vulnerability assessments, security configuration reviews, patching, or remediation of network and operating-system security findings.

- Cisco CCNA or CCNP (or equivalent vendor certification).

- Relevant military communications/signal corps training or certification.

- Relevant network or cybersecurity certification such as Security+, CCNP Security, CISSP, or equivalent practical experience.

Travel Required:

- Minimal- 5% Domestic and International

Citizenship:

- Must be a US Person under ITAR definition (U.S. Citizen, green card holder or person covered under our existing ITAR license)

Physical Requirements:

- Onsite or remote: 50% onsite in Bingen, WA

- Vision: able to see and read computer screens and other electronic equipment with screens, able to read documents, reports and engineering drawings. Daily

- Hearing: able to participate in conversations in person and via teleconference or phone and to hear sounds on the production floor including safety warnings or alarms. Daily.

- Speaking: able to speak in conversations and meetings, deliver information and participate in communications. Daily.

- Equipment Operation (personal computer, telephone, copies, fax machine, and related office equipment and using electronic identification card to enter building floors and internal doors): able to operate most office and personal electronic equipment. Daily.

- Carrying: able to carry documents, tools, drawings, electronic equipment up to 30lbs/14kgs. Daily.

- Lifting: able to lift documents, tools, drawings, electronic equipment up to 30lbs/14kgs. Daily.

- Pushing / Pulling: able to push and pull small office furniture and some equipment and tools. Occasionally.

- Sitting: able to sit for long periods of time in meetings, working on the computer. Daily.

- Squatting / Kneeling: able to squat or kneel to retrieve or replace items stored on low shelving. Occasionally.

- Standing: able to stand for discussions in offices or on the production floor. Daily.

- Travel: able to travel independently and at short notice. Occasionally.

- Walking (include routine walking such as to a shared printer to retrieve documents): able to walk through office and production areas including uneven surfaces. Daily.

- Personal Protective Equipment required: Required PPE includes, but is not limited to, Safety Shoes, Safety Glasses, Hearing Protection, Respirators/Masks, and/or Protective Gloves as required by site and/or customer site

- Administrative position only PPE required: Steel-toed shoes are required for all shop floor visits, appropriate hearing/eye protection may also be required when visiting the shop floor.

Salary range based on the required profile: $97k to $155k /year. Actual minimum and maximum may vary based on geographic differential. Individual pay is based on skills, experience, and other relevant factors. This position offers the following benefits: Medical insurance, Dental insurance, Vision insurance, Prescription insurance, Employee Assistance Program, Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts, Basic & Voluntary Life and Accidental Death & Dismemberment insurance, Short and Long-term Disability insurance, 401(k), Paid time off including paid holidays, Tuition Assistance, Bonus(es) subject to performance criteria.
